lastTouchedVersion.title: Config Last Touched Version
lastTouchedVersion.description: OpenClaw version that most recently wrote this config.

modelPolicyAllowlist.title: Model Policy Allowlist Migration
modelPolicyAllowlist.description: Records that legacy model-map restrictions were preserved or evaluated.

migrations.title: Config Migration Markers
migrations.description: Bounded compatibility markers for completed config migrations.

meta.title: Compatibility Metadata
meta.description: Backward-readable compatibility metadata retained so older binaries can refuse unsafe config downgrades.

enabled.title: Shell Environment Import Enabled
enabled.description: Enables loading environment variables from the user shell profile during startup initialization. Keep enabled for developer machines, or disable in locked-down service environments with explicit env management.

timeoutMs.title: Shell Environment Import Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for shell environment resolution before fallback behavior applies. Use tighter timeouts for faster startup, or increase when shell initialization is heavy.

shellEnv.title: Shell Environment Import
shellEnv.description: Shell environment import controls for loading variables from your login shell during startup. Keep this enabled when you depend on profile-defined secrets or PATH customizations.

vars.title: Environment Variable Overrides
vars.description: Explicit key/value environment variable overrides merged into runtime process environment for OpenClaw. Use this for deterministic env configuration instead of relying only on shell profile side effects.

env.title: Environment
env.description: Environment import and override settings used to supply runtime variables to the gateway process. Use this section to control shell-env loading and explicit variable injection behavior.

accessMode.title: Setup Discovery Access
accessMode.description: Discovery consent for guided setup: "full" scans silently while "guarded" asks before inspecting local applications.

appRecommendations.title: Setup App Recommendations
appRecommendations.description: Controls whether guided setup may use installed-application labels to recommend relevant plugins and skills.

lastRunAt.title: Wizard Last Run Timestamp
lastRunAt.description: Timestamp of the last successfully committed wizard run.

lastRunVersion.title: Wizard Last Run Version
lastRunVersion.description: OpenClaw version used by the last wizard run.

lastRunCommit.title: Wizard Last Run Commit
lastRunCommit.description: Source commit used by the last development wizard run.

lastRunCommand.title: Wizard Last Run Command
lastRunCommand.description: Command that invoked the last wizard run.

lastRunMode.title: Wizard Last Run Mode
lastRunMode.description: Whether the last wizard run targeted "local" or "remote" setup.

securityAcknowledgedAt.title: Wizard Security Acknowledgement Timestamp
securityAcknowledgedAt.description: Timestamp of the setup security acknowledgement, committed with the target config.

wizard.title: Setup Preferences
wizard.description: User-owned setup preferences. Machine-owned wizard history and acknowledgement state live in the shared state database.

enabled.title: Diagnostics Enabled
enabled.description: Master toggle for diagnostics instrumentation output in logs and telemetry wiring paths. Defaults to enabled; set false only in tightly constrained environments.

flags.title: Diagnostics Flags
flags.description: Enable targeted diagnostics logs by flag (e.g. ["telegram.http"]). Supports wildcards like "telegram.*" or "*".

enabled.title: OpenTelemetry Enabled
enabled.description: Enables OpenTelemetry export pipeline for traces, metrics, and logs based on configured endpoint/protocol settings. Keep disabled unless your collector endpoint and auth are fully configured.

endpoint.title: OpenTelemetry Endpoint
endpoint.description: Collector endpoint URL used for OpenTelemetry export transport, including scheme and port. Use a reachable, trusted collector endpoint and monitor ingestion errors after rollout.

tracesEndpoint.title: OpenTelemetry Traces Endpoint
tracesEndpoint.description: Signal-specific OTLP/HTTP trace endpoint. When set, this overrides diagnostics.otel.endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for trace export only.

metricsEndpoint.title: OpenTelemetry Metrics Endpoint
metricsEndpoint.description: Signal-specific OTLP/HTTP metrics endpoint. When set, this overrides diagnostics.otel.endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for metrics export only.

logsEndpoint.title: OpenTelemetry Logs Endpoint
logsEndpoint.description: Signal-specific OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint. When set, this overrides diagnostics.otel.endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for log export only.

protocol.title: OpenTelemetry Protocol
protocol.description: OTel transport protocol for telemetry export. Only "http/protobuf" is accepted; run "openclaw doctor --fix" to repair a persisted legacy "grpc" value or get source-specific manual-edit guidance.

headers.title: OpenTelemetry Headers
headers.description: Additional HTTP request headers sent with OpenTelemetry export requests, often used for tenant auth or routing. Keep secrets in env-backed values and avoid unnecessary header sprawl.

serviceName.title: OpenTelemetry Service Name
serviceName.description: Service name reported in telemetry resource attributes to identify this gateway instance in observability backends. Use stable names so dashboards and alerts remain consistent over deployments.

metricNamePrefix.title: OpenTelemetry Metric Name Prefix
metricNamePrefix.description: Replaces the default "openclaw." prefix on OpenClaw-owned metric names. Use an empty string to remove the prefix, or up to 128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens, and slashes starting with a letter. Include any separator you need, for example "acme."; standard gen_ai.* metric names are unchanged. Changing this value requires updating dashboards and alerts that query the old names.

traces.title: OpenTelemetry Traces Enabled
traces.description: Enable trace signal export to the configured OpenTelemetry collector endpoint. Keep enabled when latency/debug tracing is needed, and disable if you only want metrics/logs.

metrics.title: OpenTelemetry Metrics Enabled
metrics.description: Enable metrics signal export to the configured OpenTelemetry collector endpoint. Keep enabled for runtime health dashboards, and disable only if metric volume must be minimized.

logs.title: OpenTelemetry Logs Enabled
logs.description: Enable log signal export through OpenTelemetry in addition to local logging sinks. Use this when centralized log correlation is required across services and agents.

logsExporter.title: OpenTelemetry Logs Exporter
logsExporter.description: Log export sink for diagnostics.otel.logs. Use "otlp" for the configured OTLP logs endpoint, "stdout" for one JSON record per stdout line in container log pipelines, and "both" when both sinks are required.

sampleRate.title: OpenTelemetry Trace Sample Rate
sampleRate.description: Trace sampling rate (0-1) controlling how much trace traffic is exported to observability backends. Lower rates reduce overhead/cost, while higher rates improve debugging fidelity.

flushIntervalMs.title: OpenTelemetry Flush Interval (ms)
flushIntervalMs.description: Interval in milliseconds for periodic telemetry flush from buffers to the collector. Increase to reduce export chatter, or lower for faster visibility during active incident response.

captureContent.title: OpenTelemetry Content Capture
captureContent.description: Opt-in OTEL span content capture. Defaults to off; true captures non-system message and tool content.

otel.title: OpenTelemetry
otel.description: OpenTelemetry export settings for traces, metrics, and logs emitted by gateway components. Use this when integrating with centralized observability backends and distributed tracing pipelines.

enabled.title: Cache Trace Enabled
enabled.description: Log cache trace snapshots for embedded agent runs (default: false).

cacheTrace.title: Cache Trace
cacheTrace.description: Cache-trace logging settings for observing cache decisions and payload context in embedded runs. Enable this temporarily for debugging and disable afterward to reduce sensitive log footprint.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Diagnostics controls for targeted tracing, telemetry export, and cache inspection during debugging. Keep baseline diagnostics minimal in production and enable deeper signals only when investigating issues.

level.title: Log Level
level.description: Primary log level threshold for runtime logger output: "silent", "fatal", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", or "trace". Keep "info" or "warn" for production, and use debug/trace only during investigation.

file.title: Log File Path
file.description: Optional file path for persisted log output in addition to or instead of console logging. Use a managed writable path and align retention/rotation with your operational policy.

consoleLevel.title: Console Log Level
consoleLevel.description: Console-specific log threshold: "silent", "fatal", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", or "trace" for terminal output control. Use this to keep local console quieter while retaining richer file logging if needed.

consoleStyle.title: Console Log Style
consoleStyle.description: Console output format style: "pretty" or "json". Use json for machine parsing pipelines and pretty for human-first terminal workflows.

redactPatterns.title: Custom Redaction Patterns
redactPatterns.description: Additional custom redact regex patterns applied to log output, persisted transcript text, and safety-boundary UI/tool/diagnostic payloads before emission. Use this to mask org-specific tokens and identifiers not covered by built-in redaction rules.

enabled.title: Audit Ledger Enabled
enabled.description: Records new run, tool, and enabled message audit events. Default: true. Disabling event inserts does not immediately delete existing records; retained rows remain queryable until they expire.

executionIdentity.title: Execution Identity Audit
executionIdentity.description: Retains bounded execution-identity attribution for exact-run inspection. Default: false. Requires logging.audit.enabled; restart the Gateway after changing it.

messages.title: Message Audit Scope
messages.description: Controls content-free message lifecycle records: "off" (default), "direct" for known direct conversations only, or "all" for direct, group, channel, and unknown conversation kinds. Both logging.audit.enabled and logging.audit.messages are startup-scoped; restart the Gateway after changing either setting.

audit.title: Audit Ledger
audit.description: Bounded metadata-only audit history for operator review. Run and tool records are enabled by default; message lifecycle metadata is a separate privacy-sensitive opt-in. The background writer is best-effort rather than a lossless compliance archive.

logging.title: Logging
logging.description: Logging behavior controls for severity, output destinations, formatting, and sensitive-data redaction. Keep levels and redaction strict enough for production while preserving useful diagnostics.

channel.title: Update Channel
channel.description: Update channel for git + npm installs ("stable", "extended-stable", "beta", or "dev"). Extended-stable is package-only: installation is foreground-only, with optional read-only startup hints.

checkOnStart.title: Update Check on Start
checkOnStart.description: Checks the OpenClaw update endpoint when the gateway starts, including read-only extended-stable hints (default: true). Set false to disable update checks and anonymous update pings.

enabled.title: Auto Update Enabled
enabled.description: Enable background auto-update for stable and beta package installs; extended-stable never auto-applies (default: false).

update.title: Updates
update.description: Update-channel and startup-check behavior for keeping OpenClaw runtime versions current. Use conservative channels in production and more experimental channels only in controlled environments.

enabled.title: Anonymous Feature Statistics
enabled.description: Shares enabled channel and provider names, plugin count, and recent session count with the daily update check. Disabled by default and always disabled when DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

consentedAt.title: Feature Statistics Consent Timestamp
consentedAt.description: ISO timestamp recording when the operator accepted or declined anonymous feature statistics. Prevents the setup wizard from asking again.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Explicit consent for anonymous feature statistics attached to the daily update check. Feature statistics are disabled by default and never include messages, credentials, or identifiers.

enabled.title: Browser Enabled
enabled.description: Enables browser capability wiring in the gateway so browser tools and CDP-driven workflows can run. Disable when browser automation is not needed to reduce surface area and startup work.

allowSystemProfileImport.title: Allow System Profile Import
allowSystemProfileImport.description: Allows macOS hosts to import cookies from a local Chrome-family system profile into a managed OpenClaw browser profile. Disable this to prevent browser profile cookie import and its macOS Keychain consent prompt.

evaluateEnabled.title: Browser Evaluate Enabled
evaluateEnabled.description: Enables browser-side evaluate helpers for runtime script evaluation capabilities where supported. Keep disabled unless your workflows require evaluate semantics beyond snapshots/navigation.

cdpUrl.title: Browser CDP URL
cdpUrl.description: CDP/DevTools endpoint URL used to attach to an externally managed browser instance. Use this for centralized browser hosts, tunnels, or existing-session attachment, and keep URL access restricted to trusted network paths.

executablePath.title: Browser Executable Path
executablePath.description: Explicit browser executable path when auto-discovery is insufficient for your host environment. Use an absolute stable path, or a path starting with ~ for your OS home directory, so launch behavior stays deterministic across restarts.

headless.title: Browser Headless Mode
headless.description: Forces browser launch in headless mode when the local launcher starts browser instances. Keep headless enabled for server environments and disable only when visible UI debugging is required.

noSandbox.title: Browser No-Sandbox Mode
noSandbox.description: Disables Chromium sandbox isolation flags for environments where sandboxing fails at runtime. Keep this off whenever possible because process isolation protections are reduced.

attachOnly.title: Browser Attach-only Mode
attachOnly.description: Restricts browser mode to attach-only behavior without starting local browser processes. Use this when all browser sessions are externally managed by a remote CDP provider.

defaultProfile.title: Browser Default Profile
defaultProfile.description: Default browser profile name selected when callers do not explicitly choose a profile. Use a stable low-privilege profile as the default to reduce accidental cross-context state use.

mode.title: Browser Snapshot Mode
mode.description: Default snapshot extraction mode controlling how page content is transformed for agent consumption. Choose the mode that balances readability, fidelity, and token footprint for your workflows.

snapshotDefaults.title: Browser Snapshot Defaults
snapshotDefaults.description: Default snapshot capture configuration used when callers do not provide explicit snapshot options. Tune this for consistent capture behavior across channels and automation paths.

dangerouslyAllowPrivateNetwork.title: Browser Dangerously Allow Private Network
dangerouslyAllowPrivateNetwork.description: Allows access to private-network address ranges from browser tooling. Default is disabled when unset; enable only for explicitly trusted private-network destinations.

allowRfc2544BenchmarkRange.title: Browser Allow RFC 2544 Benchmark Range
allowRfc2544BenchmarkRange.description: Allow RFC 2544 benchmark-range IPs (198.18.0.0/15) for trusted fake-IP proxy environments.

allowIpv6UniqueLocalRange.title: Browser Allow IPv6 Unique Local Range
allowIpv6UniqueLocalRange.description: Allow IPv6 Unique Local Addresses (fc00::/7) for trusted fake-IP proxy environments.

allowedHostnames.title: Browser Allowed Hostnames
allowedHostnames.description: Exact hostnames or IP literals allowed by browser SSRF policy checks. Keep the list minimal.

blockedHostnames.title: Browser Blocked Hostnames
blockedHostnames.description: Hostname patterns denied before DNS and allow rules, even with private-network access enabled. Supports exact hosts and "*.example.com" for subdomains only; add "example.com" separately to block the apex. Empty or unset adds no denials.

ssrfPolicy.title: Browser SSRF Policy
ssrfPolicy.description: Server-side request forgery guardrail settings for browser/network fetch paths that could reach internal hosts. Keep restrictive defaults in production and open only explicitly approved targets.

cdpPort.title: Browser Profile CDP Port
cdpPort.description: Per-profile local CDP port used when connecting to browser instances by port instead of URL. Use unique ports per profile to avoid connection collisions.

cdpUrl.title: Browser Profile CDP URL
cdpUrl.description: Per-profile CDP/DevTools endpoint URL used for explicit browser routing by profile name. Use this for remote CDP hosts, tunnels, or existing-session profiles that should attach through a running Chrome DevTools endpoint.

userDataDir.title: Browser Profile User Data Dir
userDataDir.description: Per-profile Chromium user data directory for existing-session attachment through Chrome DevTools MCP. Use this for Brave, Edge, Chromium, or non-default Chrome profiles when the built-in auto-connect path would pick the wrong browser data directory on the selected host or browser node. Paths starting with ~ expand to the OS home directory.

mcpCommand.title: Browser Profile Chrome MCP Command
mcpCommand.description: Per-profile Chrome DevTools MCP command for existing-session attachment. Defaults to npx.

mcpArgs.title: Browser Profile Chrome MCP Args
mcpArgs.description: Extra per-profile Chrome DevTools MCP arguments for existing-session attachment, such as --no-usage-statistics. Endpoint arguments here override the built-in auto-connect or browser URL selection.

driver.title: Browser Profile Driver
driver.description: Per-profile browser driver mode. Use "openclaw" (or legacy "clawd") for CDP-based profiles, "existing-session" for Chrome DevTools MCP attachment, or "extension" for the authenticated Chrome extension relay.

headless.title: Browser Profile Headless Mode
headless.description: Per-profile headless override for locally launched browser instances. Use this when one profile should stay headless without forcing browser.headless for every other profile.

executablePath.title: Browser Profile Executable Path
executablePath.description: Per-profile browser executable path for locally launched managed browser profiles. Overrides browser.executablePath and accepts paths starting with ~ for the OS home directory.

attachOnly.title: Browser Profile Attach-only Mode
attachOnly.description: Per-profile attach-only override that skips local browser launch and only attaches to an existing CDP endpoint. Useful when one profile is externally managed but others are locally launched.

profiles.title: Browser Profiles
profiles.description: Named browser profile connection map used for explicit routing to CDP ports or URLs with optional metadata. Keep profile names consistent and avoid overlapping endpoint definitions.

enabled.title: Browser Tab Cleanup Enabled
enabled.description: Enables cleanup of idle tracked browser tabs for primary-agent sessions. Disable only when external tooling owns tab lifecycle completely.

tabCleanup.title: Browser Tab Cleanup
tabCleanup.description: Best-effort cleanup policy for browser tabs opened by primary-agent sessions. Keep enabled to avoid stale sandbox or managed-browser tabs accumulating across long-lived gateways.

allowLegacyAuth.title: Allow Legacy Browser Relay Auth
allowLegacyAuth.description: Temporarily accepts legacy Bearer, Basic, and token-subprotocol relay authentication. Default: true for one migration window. Set false after every extension and external CDP client uses Browser Relay Authentication v2.

extensionRelay.title: Browser Extension Relay
extensionRelay.description: Chrome extension relay authentication compatibility settings. Keep the legacy window only while older paired extensions or external CDP clients still need it.

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: Browser runtime controls for local or remote CDP attachment, profile routing, and screenshot/snapshot behavior. Keep defaults unless your automation workflow requires custom browser transport settings.

seamColor.title: Accent Color
seamColor.description: Primary accent color used by UI surfaces for emphasis, badges, and visual identity cues. Use high-contrast values that remain readable across light/dark themes.

accent.title: User Accent Color
accent.description: User-selected Control UI accent color in #RRGGBB format. Overrides ui.seamColor; clear it to restore the configured seam color or theme default.

ui.title: UI
ui.description: UI presentation settings for accenting and operator display preferences. Use this for readability customization without changing runtime behavior.

enabled.title: Secret Egress Proxy Enabled
enabled.description: Enables secret egress substitution for Gateway-hosted agent subprocesses. Default: false.

allowedHosts.title: Secret Egress Proxy Allowed Hosts
allowedHosts.description: Opt-in traffic allowlist for requests and CONNECT tunnels. When present, destinations must appear in this list, a per-secret host binding, or bypassHosts. An empty list permits only bound or bypassed hosts. Restart the Gateway after changing it.

bypassHosts.title: Secret Egress Proxy Bypass Hosts
bypassHosts.description: Exact hostnames that use authenticated blind CONNECT tunnels for certificate-pinned clients. Sentinels remain ciphertext and will fail vendor authentication instead of exposing plaintext.

egressProxy.title: Secret Egress Proxy
egressProxy.description: Gateway-owned loopback proxy that replaces shared-store secret sentinels only at outbound request time. Restart the Gateway after changing this startup-scoped section.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Secret reference providers, shared-store behavior, and optional subprocess egress protection.

profiles.title: Auth Profiles
profiles.description: Named auth profiles (provider + mode + optional email).

order.title: Auth Profile Order
order.description: Ordered auth profile IDs per provider (used for automatic failover).

auth.title: Auth
auth.description: Authentication profile root used for multi-profile provider credentials and cooldown-based failover ordering. Keep profiles minimal and explicit so automatic failover behavior stays auditable.

enabled.title: ACP Enabled
enabled.description: Global ACP feature gate. Keep disabled unless ACP runtime + policy are configured.

enabled.title: ACP Dispatch Enabled
enabled.description: Independent dispatch gate for ACP session turns (default: true). Set false to keep ACP commands available while blocking ACP turn execution.

backend.title: ACP Backend
backend.description: Default ACP runtime backend id (for example: acpx). Must match a registered ACP runtime plugin backend.

fallbacks.title: ACP Fallback Backends
fallbacks.description: Ordered list of fallback ACP backend ids tried when the primary backend fails with UNAVAILABLE (for example: rate-limit / quota exhausted). Each entry must match a registered ACP runtime plugin backend.

defaultAgent.title: ACP Default Agent
defaultAgent.description: Fallback ACP target agent id used when ACP spawns do not specify an explicit target.

allowedAgents.title: ACP Allowed Agents
allowedAgents.description: Allowlist of ACP target agent ids permitted for ACP runtime sessions. Empty means no additional allowlist restriction.

repeatSuppression.title: ACP Stream Repeat Suppression
repeatSuppression.description: When true (default), suppress repeated ACP status/tool projection lines in a turn while keeping raw ACP events unchanged.

deliveryMode.title: ACP Stream Delivery Mode
deliveryMode.description: ACP delivery style: live streams projected output incrementally, final_only buffers all projected ACP output until terminal turn events.

tagVisibility.title: ACP Stream Tag Visibility
tagVisibility.description: Per-sessionUpdate visibility overrides for ACP projection (for example usage_update, available_commands_update).

stream.title: ACP Stream
stream.description: ACP streaming projection controls for chunk sizing, metadata visibility, and deduped delivery behavior.

installCommand.title: ACP Runtime Install Command
installCommand.description: Optional operator install/setup command shown by `/acp install` and `/acp doctor` when ACP backend wiring is missing.

acp.title: ACP
acp.description: ACP runtime controls for enabling dispatch, selecting backends, constraining allowed agent targets, and selecting streamed turn projection behavior.

mode.title: Model Catalog Mode
mode.description: Controls provider catalog behavior: "merge" keeps built-ins and overlays your custom providers, while "replace" uses only your configured providers. In "merge", matching provider IDs preserve non-empty agent models.json baseUrl values, while apiKey values are preserved only when the provider is not SecretRef-managed in current config/auth-profile context; SecretRef-managed providers refresh apiKey from current source markers, and matching model contextWindow/maxTokens use the higher value between explicit and implicit entries.

baseUrl.title: Model Provider Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL for the provider endpoint used to serve model requests for that provider entry. Use HTTPS endpoints and keep URLs environment-specific through config templating where needed.

apiKey.title: Model Provider API Key
apiKey.description: Provider credential used for API-key based authentication when the provider requires direct key auth. Use secret/env substitution and avoid storing real keys in committed config files.

auth.title: Model Provider Auth Mode
auth.description: Selects provider auth style: "api-key" for API key auth, "token" for bearer token auth, "oauth" for OAuth credentials, and "aws-sdk" for AWS credential resolution. Match this to your provider requirements.

api.title: Model Provider API Adapter
api.description: Provider API adapter selection controlling request/response compatibility handling for model calls. Use the adapter that matches your upstream provider protocol to avoid feature mismatch.

maxTokens.title: Model Provider Max Tokens
maxTokens.description: Default maximum output token budget applied to models under this provider when a model entry does not set maxTokens.

timeoutSeconds.title: Model Provider Request Timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Optional per-provider model request timeout in seconds. Provider-level request settings affect explicit provider-owned model rows; they do not create implicit models. For custom providers, set it alongside the provider baseUrl and models. Applies to provider HTTP fetches, including connect, headers, body, and total request abort handling, and also raises the LLM idle/stream watchdog ceiling for this provider above the implicit ~120s default. Use this for slow local or self-hosted model servers, or for cloud providers that buffer reasoning tokens silently on the wire (Gemini preview, large-tool-payload Claude/Opus), instead of changing global agent timeouts.

region.title: Model Provider Region
region.description: Optional provider deployment/API region interpreted by providers that expose regional endpoints. Use provider docs for supported values; baseUrl overrides usually take precedence when both are set.

injectNumCtxForOpenAICompat.title: Model Provider Inject num_ctx (OpenAI Compat)
injectNumCtxForOpenAICompat.description: Controls whether OpenClaw injects `options.num_ctx` for Ollama providers configured with the OpenAI-compatible adapter (`openai-completions`). Default is true. Set false only if your proxy/upstream rejects unknown `options` payload fields.

params.title: Model Provider Runtime Parameters
params.description: Provider-specific runtime parameters interpreted by provider plugins. Keep keys documented by the provider, and prefer explicit provider docs over ad hoc shared assumptions.

id.title: Model Provider Runtime ID
id.description: Provider agent runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli". OpenAI on the official endpoint defaults to the Codex harness when omitted.

agentRuntime.title: Model Provider Runtime
agentRuntime.description: Optional low-level agent runtime policy for this provider. Use provider/model runtime policy instead of agent-wide runtime pins; omitted/default lets OpenClaw choose the runtime for the selected provider.

command.title: Model Provider Local Service Command
command.description: Absolute executable path for the local model server process. Keep this path explicit so provider startup is deterministic and does not depend on shell PATH lookup.

args.title: Model Provider Local Service Arguments
args.description: Argument list passed to the local model server command without shell expansion.

cwd.title: Model Provider Local Service Working Directory
cwd.description: Working directory for the local model server process.

env.title: Model Provider Local Service Environment
env.description: Additional environment variables for the local model server process. Values that look secret are redacted from config snapshots.

healthUrl.title: Model Provider Local Service Health URL
healthUrl.description: Readiness URL probed before model requests. If omitted, OpenClaw uses the provider baseUrl with /models appended.

readyTimeoutMs.title: Model Provider Local Service Ready Timeout
readyTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the local model server readiness probe after starting the process.

idleStopMs.title: Model Provider Local Service Idle Stop
idleStopMs.description: Milliseconds to keep an OpenClaw-started local model server alive after the last request finishes. Set 0 to keep it alive until OpenClaw exits.

localService.title: Model Provider Local Service
localService.description: Optional on-demand local model server process for this provider. OpenClaw probes healthUrl, starts the command when needed, waits for readiness, and then sends the model request.

headers.title: Model Provider Headers
headers.description: Static HTTP headers merged into provider requests for tenant routing, proxy auth, or custom gateway requirements. Use this sparingly and keep sensitive header values in secrets.

authHeader.title: Model Provider Authorization Header
authHeader.description: When true, credentials are sent via the HTTP Authorization header even if alternate auth is possible. Use this only when your provider or proxy explicitly requires Authorization forwarding.

headers.title: Model Provider Request Headers
headers.description: Extra headers merged into provider requests after default attribution and auth resolution.

mode.title: Model Provider Request Auth Mode
mode.description: Auth override mode: "provider-default", "authorization-bearer", or "header".

mode.title: Model Provider Request Auth Mode
mode.description: Auth override mode: "provider-default", "authorization-bearer", or "header".

token.title: Model Provider Request Bearer Token
token.description: Bearer token used when auth mode is authorization-bearer.

mode.title: Model Provider Request Auth Mode
mode.description: Auth override mode: "provider-default", "authorization-bearer", or "header".

headerName.title: Model Provider Request Auth Header Name
headerName.description: Custom auth header name used when auth mode is header.

value.title: Model Provider Request Auth Header Value
value.description: Custom auth header value used when auth mode is header.

prefix.title: Model Provider Request Auth Header Prefix
prefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to request.auth.value when auth mode is header.

auth.title: Model Provider Request Auth Override
auth.description: Override provider request authentication behavior for this provider.

mode.title: Model Provider Request Proxy Mode
mode.description: Proxy override mode for model-provider requests: "env-proxy" or "explicit-proxy".

ca.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS CA
ca.description: Custom CA bundle used to verify the proxy TLS certificate chain.

cert.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Cert
cert.description: Client TLS certificate presented to the proxy when mutual TLS is required.

key.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Key
key.description: Private key paired with request.proxy.tls.cert for proxy mutual TLS.

passphrase.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Passphrase
passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used to decrypt request.proxy.tls.key.

serverName.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Server Name
serverName.description: Optional SNI/server-name override used when establishing TLS to the proxy.

insecureSkipVerify.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Skip Verify
insecureSkipVerify.description: Skips proxy TLS certificate verification. Use only for controlled development environments.

tls.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS
tls.description: Optional TLS settings used when connecting to the configured proxy.

mode.title: Model Provider Request Proxy Mode
mode.description: Proxy override mode for model-provider requests: "env-proxy" or "explicit-proxy".

url.title: Model Provider Request Proxy URL
url.description: Explicit proxy URL used when request.proxy.mode is explicit-proxy. Credentials embedded in the URL are treated as sensitive and redacted from snapshots.

ca.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS CA
ca.description: Custom CA bundle used to verify the proxy TLS certificate chain.

cert.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Cert
cert.description: Client TLS certificate presented to the proxy when mutual TLS is required.

key.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Key
key.description: Private key paired with request.proxy.tls.cert for proxy mutual TLS.

passphrase.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Passphrase
passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used to decrypt request.proxy.tls.key.

serverName.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Server Name
serverName.description: Optional SNI/server-name override used when establishing TLS to the proxy.

insecureSkipVerify.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS Skip Verify
insecureSkipVerify.description: Skips proxy TLS certificate verification. Use only for controlled development environments.

tls.title: Model Provider Request Proxy TLS
tls.description: Optional TLS settings used when connecting to the configured proxy.

proxy.title: Model Provider Request Proxy
proxy.description: Optional proxy override for model-provider requests. Use "env-proxy" to honor environment proxy settings or "explicit-proxy" to route through a specific proxy URL.

ca.title: Model Provider Request TLS CA
ca.description: Custom CA bundle used to verify the upstream TLS certificate chain.

cert.title: Model Provider Request TLS Cert
cert.description: Client TLS certificate presented to the upstream endpoint when mutual TLS is required.

key.title: Model Provider Request TLS Key
key.description: Private key paired with request.tls.cert for upstream mutual TLS.

passphrase.title: Model Provider Request TLS Passphrase
passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used to decrypt request.tls.key.

serverName.title: Model Provider Request TLS Server Name
serverName.description: Optional SNI/server-name override used when establishing upstream TLS.

insecureSkipVerify.title: Model Provider Request TLS Skip Verify
insecureSkipVerify.description: Skips upstream TLS certificate verification. Use only for controlled development environments.

tls.title: Model Provider Request TLS
tls.description: Optional TLS settings used when connecting directly to the upstream model endpoint.

allowPrivateNetwork.title: Model Provider Request Allow Private Network
allowPrivateNetwork.description: When true, allow model-provider HTTP requests to private, CGNAT, or similar ranges through the provider HTTP fetch guard (fetchWithSsrFGuard). Custom/local provider base URLs already trust the exact configured origin, except metadata, link-local, and local-use NAT64 (64:ff9b:1::/48) origins; set this to false to opt out of that trust. OpenAI Responses WebSocket reuses request for headers/TLS but does not use that fetch SSRF path. Use true only for operator-controlled self-hosted endpoints that must reach private origins outside the configured baseUrl origin.

request.title: Model Provider Request Overrides
request.description: Optional request overrides for model-provider requests, including extra headers, auth overrides, proxy routing, TLS client settings, and optional allowPrivateNetwork for trusted self-hosted endpoints. Use these only when your upstream or enterprise network path requires transport customization.

id.title: Model Runtime ID
id.description: Model agent runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli".

agentRuntime.title: Model Runtime
agentRuntime.description: Optional low-level agent runtime policy for this specific model. Model runtime policy overrides the provider runtime policy.

maxBytes.title: Model Image Max Bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum encoded image payload size accepted by the provider for this model.

maxPixels.title: Model Image Max Pixels
maxPixels.description: Maximum image pixel count accepted by the provider for this model.

maxSidePx.title: Model Image Max Side
maxSidePx.description: Maximum image width or height accepted by the provider for this model.

preferredSidePx.title: Model Image Preferred Side
preferredSidePx.description: Preferred image resize side for balanced compression. Leave unset to use OpenClaw's conservative default.

tokenMode.title: Model Image Token Mode
tokenMode.description: Provider image token accounting style: "tile", "detail", or "provider".

image.title: Model Image Input
image.description: Optional image input limits for this model, such as maximum side length, maximum pixels, and preferred compression side.

mediaInput.title: Model Media Input
mediaInput.description: Optional model media capability metadata used by tools to choose conservative image compression defaults.

models.title: Model Provider Model List
models.description: Declared model list for a provider including identifiers, metadata, provider-specific params, and optional compatibility/cost hints. Keep IDs exact to provider catalog values so selection and fallback resolve correctly.

providers.title: Model Providers
providers.description: Provider map keyed by provider ID containing connection/auth settings and concrete model definitions. Built-in providers may be tuned with provider-level overlays; custom providers must include baseUrl and models. Use stable provider keys so references from agents and tooling remain portable across environments.

enabled.title: Model Catalog Refresh Enabled
enabled.description: Fetch hosted model catalog updates in the background (default: true). Set to false to disable all remote model catalog traffic.

url.title: Model Catalog Refresh URL
url.description: Override the hosted model catalog URL for a self-hosted HTTPS mirror (localhost HTTP is allowed for testing). Changes apply after a Gateway restart.

catalogRefresh.title: Model Catalog Refresh
catalogRefresh.description: Controls background updates to the bundled model catalog. Remote rows can update model metadata but cannot change provider endpoints or headers.

models.title: Models
models.description: Model catalog root for provider definitions, merge/replace behavior, and optional Bedrock discovery integration. Keep provider definitions explicit and validated before relying on production failover paths.

enabled.title: Node Claude Agent Runs Enabled
enabled.description: Advertise paired-node Claude session continuation when the local claude binary is available (default: false). Runs still require node exec approval.

claude.title: Node Claude Agent Runs
claude.description: Controls whether this headless node host may advertise Claude CLI agent turns to the gateway.

agentRuns.title: Node Agent Runs
agentRuns.description: Opt in to approval-gated native agent turns on this headless node host. Disabled by default.

enabled.title: Node Worker Runs Enabled
enabled.description: Allow this paired node to host sessions from exact bundles installed by its Gateway (default: false).

capacity.title: Node Worker Run Capacity
capacity.description: Maximum concurrent worker sessions hosted by this node (default: the number of available CPU cores). Must be an integer from 1 through 1024.

isolation.title: Node Worker Run Isolation
isolation.description: Select the worker-session process boundary: "none" runs directly on the node host (default); "container" requires a working Docker-compatible engine and never falls back to host execution.

containerImage.title: Node Worker Run Container Image
containerImage.description: Optional Node 24.16+ or 26.1+ image for container-isolated workers (default: "node:24.19.0-slim"). Use a digest-pinned, private-registry, or preloaded image when needed; missing images are pulled on first use.

workerRuns.title: Node Worker Runs
workerRuns.description: Opt in to full OpenClaw worker session hosting from Gateway-managed bundles. Disabled by default.

enabled.title: Node Browser Proxy Enabled
enabled.description: Expose the local browser control server through node proxy routing so remote clients can use this host's browser capabilities. Keep disabled unless remote automation explicitly depends on it.

allowProfiles.title: Node Browser Proxy Allowed Profiles
allowProfiles.description: Optional allowlist of browser profile names exposed through node proxy routing. Leave empty to preserve the default full profile surface, including profile create/delete routes. When set, OpenClaw enforces least-privilege profile access and blocks persistent profile create/delete through the proxy.

browserProxy.title: Node Browser Proxy
browserProxy.description: Groups browser-proxy settings for exposing local browser control through node routing. Enable only when remote node workflows need your local browser profiles.

servers.title: Node Host MCP Servers
servers.description: Named MCP server definitions local to this node. Uses the same server shape as mcp.servers; OAuth servers are not supported by the node host.

mcp.title: Node Host MCP
mcp.description: Use MCP servers started by the headless node host and published to its paired gateway as agent tools. Restart the node host after changing this section.

enabled.title: Node Host Skills Enabled
enabled.description: Scan and publish node-hosted skills after connecting (default: true). Set false to disable node skill publication.

skills.title: Node Host Skills
skills.description: Use this section to publish skills installed in ~/.openclaw/skills from the headless node host. Restart the node host after changing skill files.

nodeHost.title: Node Host
nodeHost.description: Node host controls for features exposed from this gateway node to other nodes or clients. Keep defaults unless you intentionally proxy local capabilities across your node network.

ownership.title: Agent Ownership Generation
ownership.description: Durable multi-agent ownership generation marker. "explicit" means ambient channels, heartbeat, system-agent consults, Talk, cron, and bare CLI operations must resolve a surface-specific owner or fail closed. OpenClaw stamps this automatically when creating or migrating a fleet; omit it for a sole agent.

fallbacks.title: Model Fallbacks
fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback models (provider/model). Used when the primary model fails.

modelSelectionScope.title: Model Selection Scope
modelSelectionScope.description: Scope for chat commands and Gateway session model updates without an explicit scope: "session" (default) changes only the current session, "agent" also updates that agent's primary, and "global" also updates the shared agents.defaults.model fallback. Explicit scope flags take precedence; configured-default writes require owner/admin authority. Telegram callback pickers and the embedded local TUI stay session-only.

utilityModel.title: Utility Model
utilityModel.description: Optional lower-cost model (provider/model or alias) for short internal tasks such as generated titles and progress narration. Unset derives the primary provider's declared small model when available (otherwise the primary model); set to an empty string to disable utility routing.

primary.title: Image Model
primary.description: Optional image model (provider/model) used when the primary model lacks image input.

primary.title: Image Generation Model
primary.description: Optional image-generation model (provider/model) used by the shared image generation capability.

timeoutMs.title: Image Generation Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Default provider request timeout in milliseconds for image_generate calls. Per-call timeoutMs overrides this.

primary.title: Video Generation Model
primary.description: Optional video-generation model (provider/model) used by the shared video generation capability.

timeoutMs.title: Video Generation Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Default provider request timeout in milliseconds for video_generate calls. Per-call timeoutMs overrides this, and this value overrides provider-authored defaults.

primary.title: Music Generation Model
primary.description: Optional music-generation model (provider/model) used by the shared music generation capability.

primary.title: Voice Model
primary.description: Optional voice model (provider/model) used by speech, transcription, and realtime voice capabilities.

timeoutMs.title: Voice Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Default provider request timeout in milliseconds for voice model operations when the caller supports timeouts.

primary.title: PDF Model
primary.description: Optional PDF model (provider/model) for the PDF analysis tool. Defaults to imageModel, then session model.

pdfMaxMb.title: PDF Max Size (MB)
pdfMaxMb.description: Maximum PDF file size in megabytes for the PDF tool (default: 10).

pdfMaxPages.title: PDF Max Pages
pdfMaxPages.description: Maximum number of PDF pages to process for the PDF tool (default: 20).

id.title: Default Agent Model Runtime ID
id.description: Default-agent model runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli".

agentRuntime.title: Default Agent Model Runtime
agentRuntime.description: Optional per-model runtime policy for the default agent. Use this for model-specific runtime exceptions instead of setting a whole-agent runtime.

codeMode.title: Code Mode
codeMode.description: OpenClaw Code Mode for this exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits tools.codeMode.enabled. Agent-specific activation settings take precedence. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.

models.title: Models
models.description: Configured model catalog and per-model settings. Entries provide aliases, params, runtime metadata, and Code Mode overrides; they do not restrict model overrides.

allow.title: Allowed Models
allow.description: Allowed model override refs. Accepts aliases, full "provider/model" refs, and provider wildcards such as "openai/*". Empty permits any model.

modelPolicy.title: Model Policy
modelPolicy.description: Explicit policy for model overrides. Omit it or leave allow empty to permit any model.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Default agent workspace for bootstrap and memory files. Also used as the working directory when agents.defaults.cwd is unset. Set this explicitly when running from wrappers so path resolution stays deterministic.

cwd.title: Working Directory
cwd.description: Working directory for agent reply runs, separate from workspace bootstrap and memory files. Agent-specific cwd and session-spawned cwd take precedence. Supports ~ and relative paths; a distinct cwd requires an unsandboxed run.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Optional default skill allowlist inherited by agents that omit agents.entries.*.skills. Omit for unrestricted skills, set [] to give inheriting agents no skills, and remember explicit agents.entries.*.skills replaces this default instead of merging with it.

repoRoot.title: Repo Root
repoRoot.description: Optional repository root shown in the system prompt runtime line (overrides auto-detect).

skipOptionalBootstrapFiles.title: Skipped Optional Bootstrap Files
skipOptionalBootstrapFiles.description: Optional bootstrap files that should not be created in agent workspaces. Valid values: SOUL.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md (HEARTBEAT.md is accepted but a no-op).

contextInjection.title: Context Injection
contextInjection.description: Controls when workspace bootstrap files are injected into the system prompt: "always" (default) or "continuation-skip" for safe continuation turns after a completed assistant response.

bootstrapMaxChars.title: Bootstrap Max Chars
bootstrapMaxChars.description: Max characters of each workspace bootstrap file injected into the system prompt before truncation (default: 20000).

bootstrapTotalMaxChars.title: Bootstrap Total Max Chars
bootstrapTotalMaxChars.description: Max total characters across all injected workspace bootstrap files (default: 60000).

localModelLean.title: Enable Lean Local Model Mode (Experimental)
localModelLean.description: Explicitly restrict optional tools such as browser, automations, and message. Off by default; supported local runtimes use automatic Tool Search without this restriction. Explicit tool allows and required delivery tools are preserved.

experimental.title: Experimental Agent Flags
experimental.description: Experimental agent-default flags. Keep these off unless you are intentionally testing a preview surface.

enabled.title: Enable Startup Context
enabled.description: Enable the startup-context prelude for bare session resets (default: true). Disable this to fall back to prompt-only behavior with no runtime-loaded daily memory.

applyOn.title: Startup Context Apply On
applyOn.description: Chooses which bare reset commands get startup context: include "new", "reset", or both (default: ["new","reset"]).

dailyMemoryDays.title: Startup Context Daily Memory Days
dailyMemoryDays.description: Number of dated memory files to load counting backward from today in the configured user timezone (default: 2 for today + yesterday).

maxFileBytes.title: Startup Context Max File Bytes
maxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed per daily memory file when building startup context (default: 16384). Files over this boundary-safe read limit are skipped.

maxFileChars.title: Startup Context Max File Chars
maxFileChars.description: Maximum characters retained from each loaded daily memory file in the startup prelude (default: 1200).

maxTotalChars.title: Startup Context Max Total Chars
maxTotalChars.description: Maximum total characters retained across all loaded daily memory files in the startup prelude (default: 2800). Additional files are truncated from the prelude once this cap is reached.

startupContext.title: Startup Context
startupContext.description: Runtime-owned first-turn prelude for bare "/new" and "/reset". Use this to control whether recent daily memory files are preloaded into the first prompt instead of asking the model to decide what to read.

memoryGetMaxChars.title: Default memory_get Max Chars
memoryGetMaxChars.description: Default max characters returned by memory_get before truncation metadata and continuation notice are added. Increase to approximate older larger excerpts, but keep it bounded.

postCompactionMaxChars.title: Default Post-compaction Max Chars
postCompactionMaxChars.description: Default max characters retained from AGENTS.md during post-compaction context refresh injection. Lower this to make compaction recovery cheaper, or raise it for agents that depend on longer startup guidance.

contextLimits.title: Default Context Limits
contextLimits.description: Focused per-agent-context budget defaults for selected high-volume excerpts and injected prompt blocks. Use this to tune bounded read/injection sizes without reopening any unbounded call paths.

enabled.title: Embedded Auto-Compaction
enabled.description: Enable embedded proactive auto-compaction (default: true). Set false to stop threshold-driven embedded compaction while preserving OpenClaw overflow recovery, preflight compaction, and manual /compact.

mode.title: Compaction Mode
mode.description: Compaction strategy mode: "safeguard" (the effective default when unset) applies guardrails to preserve recent context, while "default" uses baseline summarization without them. Set "default" only if safeguard summarization causes problems for your provider.

provider.title: Compaction Provider
provider.description: Id of a registered compaction provider plugin used for summarization. When set and the provider is registered, its summarize() method is called instead of the built-in summarizeInStages pipeline. Falls back to built-in on provider failure. Leave unset to use the default built-in summarization.

thinkingLevel.title: Compaction Thinking Level
thinkingLevel.description: Thinking level used only for embedded OpenClaw compaction summaries: "off", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "adaptive", "max", "ultra", or "inherit". Defaults to the provider compaction preference, otherwise "low"; native local Ollama prefers "off". Set "inherit" to reuse the session level. Explicit settings override provider defaults, and the selected level is clamped to the actual compaction model/runtime. Native Codex app-server compaction ignores this setting because its compact request has no per-operation thinking override, and OpenClaw logs a warning.

keepRecentTokens.title: Compaction Keep Recent Tokens
keepRecentTokens.description: Minimum token budget preserved from the most recent conversation window during compaction. Use higher values to protect immediate context continuity and lower values to keep more long-tail history.

identifierPolicy.title: Compaction Identifier Policy
identifierPolicy.description: Identifier-preservation policy for compaction summaries: "strict" prepends built-in opaque-identifier retention guidance (default), while "off" disables this prefix.

recentTurnsPreserve.title: Compaction Preserve Recent Turns
recentTurnsPreserve.description: Number of most recent user/assistant turns kept verbatim outside safeguard summarization (default: 3). Raise this to preserve exact recent dialogue context, or lower it to maximize compaction savings.

enabled.title: Compaction Quality Guard Enabled
enabled.description: Enables summary quality audits and regeneration retries for safeguard compaction. Default: true in safeguard mode.

maxRetries.title: Compaction Quality Guard Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of regeneration retries after a failed safeguard summary quality audit. Use small values to bound extra latency and token cost.

qualityGuard.title: Compaction Quality Guard
qualityGuard.description: Quality-audit retry settings for safeguard compaction summaries. Safeguard mode enables this by default; set enabled: false to skip summary audits and regeneration.

enabled.title: Compaction Mid-turn Precheck Enabled
enabled.description: Enable structured mid-turn context pressure checks for embedded OpenClaw tool loops. Default: false. Keep disabled unless long tool-heavy sessions hit context overflow before normal turn-end compaction can run.

midTurnPrecheck.title: Compaction Mid-turn Precheck
midTurnPrecheck.description: Optional embedded OpenClaw tool-loop precheck that detects context pressure after a tool result is appended and before the next model call. When enabled, OpenClaw reuses existing precheck recovery to truncate tool results or compact before retrying.

postIndexSync.title: Compaction Post-Index Sync
postIndexSync.description: Controls post-compaction session memory reindex mode: "off", "async", or "await" (default: "async"). Use "await" for strongest freshness, "async" for lower compaction latency, and "off" only when session-memory sync is handled elsewhere.

postCompactionSections.title: Post-Compaction Context Sections
postCompactionSections.description: Opt-in AGENTS.md H2/H3 section names re-injected after compaction. Leave unset or set [] to disable reinjection. Explicitly set ["Session Startup", "Red Lines"] to enable the legacy default pair.

model.title: Compaction Model Override
model.description: Optional provider/model or configured bare alias used only for compaction summarization. Bare aliases resolve before dispatch; a configured literal model ID wins if it collides with an alias. Leave unset to keep using the primary agent model.

timeoutSeconds.title: Compaction Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Safety window in seconds for each built-in compaction model request (default: 180). Multi-stage compaction refreshes the window as each serial request starts, so the complete compaction can take longer; plugin-owned compaction receives one window for the complete operation.

enabled.title: Compaction Memory Flush Enabled
enabled.description: Enables pre-compaction memory flush before the runtime performs stronger history reduction near token limits. Keep enabled unless you intentionally disable memory side effects in constrained environments.

model.title: Compaction Memory Flush Model Override
model.description: Optional provider/model override used only for pre-compaction memory flush turns. Set this to a local model such as ollama/qwen3:8b when durable memory extraction should avoid the active session's paid model. The override is exact and does not inherit the active model fallback chain.

softThresholdTokens.title: Compaction Memory Flush Soft Threshold
softThresholdTokens.description: Threshold distance to compaction (in tokens) that triggers pre-compaction memory flush execution. Use earlier thresholds for safer persistence, or tighter thresholds for lower flush frequency.

forceFlushTranscriptBytes.title: Compaction Memory Flush Transcript Size Threshold
forceFlushTranscriptBytes.description: Forces pre-compaction memory flush when the model-visible transcript window reaches this threshold (bytes or strings like "2mb"). After compaction, this includes the retained tail and subsequent turns rather than discarded history. Use this to prevent long-session hangs even when token counters are stale; set to 0 to disable.

memoryFlush.title: Compaction Memory Flush
memoryFlush.description: Pre-compaction memory flush settings that run an agentic memory write before heavy compaction. Keep enabled for long sessions so salient context is persisted before aggressive trimming.

maxActiveTranscriptBytes.title: Compaction Active Transcript Size Threshold
maxActiveTranscriptBytes.description: Byte threshold that triggers normal preflight local compaction when the transcript window the model sees (since the latest compaction or reset) reaches this size (bytes or strings like "20mb"). Set to 0 or leave unset to disable. Also caps Codex app-server native rollout transcripts; oversized native threads restart fresh.

notifyUser.title: Compaction Notify User
notifyUser.description: When enabled, sends brief context-maintenance notices to the user: when compaction starts and completes (for example, '🧹 Compacting context...' and '🧹 Compaction complete'), and when a pre-compaction memory flush is exhausted so the reply continues in a degraded state (for example, '⚠️ Memory maintenance temporarily failed; continuing your reply.'). Disabled by default to keep context maintenance silent and non-intrusive.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Compaction behavior for when context nears token limits, including strategy and pre-compaction memory flush behavior. Use this when long-running sessions need stable continuity under tight context windows.

projectSettingsPolicy.title: Embedded OpenClaw Project Settings Policy
projectSettingsPolicy.description: How embedded OpenClaw handles workspace-local `.openclaw/settings.json`: "sanitize" (default) strips shellPath/shellCommandPrefix, "ignore" disables project settings entirely, and "trusted" applies project settings as-is.

executionContract.title: Embedded OpenClaw Execution Contract
executionContract.description: Embedded OpenClaw execution contract: "default" keeps the standard runner behavior, while "strict-agentic" enables structured plan tracking and non-visible turn recovery for supported OpenAI/OpenAI Codex GPT-5-family runs.

embeddedAgent.title: Embedded OpenClaw
embeddedAgent.description: Embedded OpenClaw runner hardening controls for how workspace-local agent settings are trusted and applied in OpenClaw sessions.

fastModeDefault.title: Default Agent Fast Mode
fastModeDefault.description: Default fast-mode policy for the agent loop ("auto", true, or false). Individual agent entries override it.

mode.title: Human Delay Mode
mode.description: Delay style for block replies ("off", "natural", "custom").

minMs.title: Human Delay Min (ms)
minMs.description: Minimum delay in ms for custom humanDelay (default: 800).

maxMs.title: Human Delay Max (ms)
maxMs.description: Maximum delay in ms for custom humanDelay (default: 2500).

imageMaxDimensionPx.title: Image Max Dimension (px)
imageMaxDimensionPx.description: Max image side length in pixels when sanitizing transcript/tool-result image payloads (default: 1200).

imageQuality.title: Image Quality
imageQuality.description: Image-tool media compression preference: "auto" adapts to provider/model limits and image count, "efficient" saves tokens and bytes, "balanced" keeps the current middle ground, and "high" preserves more detail for screenshots and document images.

typingIntervalSeconds.title: Typing Interval (Seconds)
typingIntervalSeconds.description: Controls typing-indicator keepalive cadence in seconds for every agent. Increase it to reduce update frequency across all typing-capable channels.

typingMode.title: Typing Mode
typingMode.description: Controls when typing starts for agents: "never", "instant", "thinking", or "message". Per-agent typingMode overrides this default.

directPolicy.title: Heartbeat Direct Policy
directPolicy.description: Controls whether heartbeat delivery may target direct/DM chats: "allow" (default) permits DM delivery and "block" suppresses direct-target sends.

timeoutSeconds.title: Heartbeat Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for a heartbeat agent turn before it is aborted. Leave unset to use agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds when set, otherwise the heartbeat cadence capped at 600 seconds.

agentId.title: Heartbeat Agent
agentId.description: Agent that owns ambient heartbeat runs when no per-agent heartbeat configuration exists. Leave unset to preserve configured-default routing.

agentId.title: System Agent Owner
agentId.description: Agent whose model and credentials own ambient system-agent and Custodian consults. Also used when models.list, models.authStatus, skills.status, doctor.memory.status, or an infer CLI command that resolves agent-owned model or auth state omits agentId or --agent; explicit request agentId always wins.

systemAgent.title: System Agent Target
systemAgent.description: Target settings for ambient OpenClaw system-agent and Custodian inference plus selected unscoped operator reads.

agentId.title: Auth Inheritance Owner
agentId.description: Agent whose legacy credential store remains the inheritance source after default-marker retirement. Written automatically during upgrade when the former owner was not main.

authInheritance.title: Auth Inheritance Target
authInheritance.description: Upgrade compatibility owner for the inherited credential store until credentials are relocated per agent.

agentId.title: Legacy Session Store Owner
agentId.description: Agent that owns retired main-agent rows or unscoped rows in a fixed legacy session store after default-marker retirement. Written automatically during upgrade when the former owner was not main or the sole agent.

sessionStore.title: Legacy Session Store Target
sessionStore.description: Upgrade compatibility owner for retired main-agent rows and fixed legacy session stores.

delegationMode.title: Sub-agent Delegation Mode
delegationMode.description: Prompt-only sub-agent delegation strength. Defaults to "prefer" in each agent's main session and "suggest" elsewhere; "prefer" strongly instructs the agent to delegate non-trivial work via sessions_spawn.

maxSpawnDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth for sub-agent spawning. Default: 5; 1 makes direct children leaves.

maxChildrenPerAgent.description: Maximum number of active children a single agent session can spawn (default: 5).

gpus.title: Sandbox Docker GPUs
gpus.description: Optional Docker GPU passthrough value passed to --gpus, for example "all" or "device=GPU-uuid". Requires a compatible host runtime such as NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

dangerouslyAllowContainerNamespaceJoin.title: Sandbox Docker Allow Container Namespace Join
dangerouslyAllowContainerNamespaceJoin.description: DANGEROUS break-glass override that allows sandbox Docker network mode container:<id>. This joins another container namespace and weakens sandbox isolation.

network.title: Sandbox Browser Network
network.description: Docker network for sandbox browser containers (default: openclaw-sandbox-browser). Use the dedicated default or a custom bridge network; "none" is unsupported because browser control requires published CDP ports.

cdpSourceRange.title: Sandbox Browser CDP Source Port Range
cdpSourceRange.description: Optional CIDR allowlist for container-edge CDP ingress (for example 172.21.0.1/32).

defaults.title: Agent Defaults
defaults.description: Shared default settings inherited by agents unless overridden per entry in agents.entries. Use defaults to enforce consistent baseline behavior and reduce duplicated per-agent configuration.

cwd.title: Agent Working Directory
cwd.description: Working directory for this agent's reply runs. Overrides agents.defaults.cwd but not session-spawned cwd; bootstrap and memory files stay in workspace. Supports ~ and relative paths; a distinct cwd requires an unsandboxed run.

utilityModel.title: Agent Utility Model
utilityModel.description: Optional per-agent utility model override for short internal tasks. Overrides agents.defaults.utilityModel.

id.title: Agent Model Runtime ID
id.description: Per-agent model runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli".

agentRuntime.title: Agent Model Runtime
agentRuntime.description: Optional per-model runtime policy for this agent. Use this for agent-specific model exceptions instead of setting a whole-agent runtime.

codeMode.title: Code Mode
codeMode.description: OpenClaw Code Mode for this agent and exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits the agent activation setting, then the shared model override, then tools.codeMode.enabled. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.

models.title: Agent Model Overrides
models.description: Per-agent model catalog overrides keyed by full provider/model IDs.

allow.title: Allowed Agent Models
allow.description: Allowed model override refs for this agent. Accepts aliases, full "provider/model" refs, and trailing prefix wildcards such as "provider/*" or "provider/namespace/*"; empty permits any model.

modelPolicy.title: Agent Model Policy
modelPolicy.description: Per-agent model override policy. An explicit allow list replaces the default policy for this agent.

thinkingDefault.title: Agent Thinking Default
thinkingDefault.description: Optional per-agent default thinking level. Overrides agents.defaults.thinkingDefault for this agent when no per-message or session override is set.

reasoningDefault.title: Agent Reasoning Default
reasoningDefault.description: Optional per-agent default reasoning visibility (on|off|stream). Applies when no per-message or session reasoning override is set.

fastModeDefault.title: Agent Fast Mode Default
fastModeDefault.description: Optional per-agent default for fast mode ("auto", true, or false). Applies when no per-message or session fast-mode override is set.

contextInjection.title: Agent Context Injection
contextInjection.description: Per-agent override for when workspace bootstrap files are injected into this agent's system prompt. Omit to inherit agents.defaults.contextInjection.

bootstrapMaxChars.title: Agent Bootstrap Max Chars
bootstrapMaxChars.description: Per-agent override for max characters of each workspace bootstrap file injected into this agent's system prompt. Omit to inherit agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars.

bootstrapTotalMaxChars.title: Agent Bootstrap Total Max Chars
bootstrapTotalMaxChars.description: Per-agent override for max total characters across all workspace bootstrap files injected into this agent's system prompt. Omit to inherit agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars.

localModelLean.title: Agent Lean Local Model Mode
localModelLean.description: Per-agent override for lean local-model mode. Enable it for one smaller local-model agent without trimming tools from every agent.

experimental.title: Agent Experimental Flags
experimental.description: Per-agent experimental flags. Omitted fields inherit agents.defaults.experimental.

skills.title: Agent Skill Filter
skills.description: Optional allowlist of skills for this agent. If omitted, the agent inherits agents.defaults.skills when set; otherwise skills stay unrestricted. Set [] for no skills. An explicit list fully replaces inherited defaults instead of merging with them.

typingMode.title: Agent Typing Mode
typingMode.description: Overrides the default typing start policy for one agent without changing other agents.

maxSkillsPromptChars.title: Agent Skills Prompt Max Chars
maxSkillsPromptChars.description: Per-agent override for the skills prompt character budget. This extends the existing skills.limits.maxSkillsPromptChars path instead of routing the same budget through contextLimits.

skillsLimits.title: Agent Skills Limits
skillsLimits.description: Optional per-agent overrides for skills subsystem budgets. Use this when an agent needs a different skills prompt budget without introducing a second generic context-limits path.

memoryGetMaxChars.title: Agent memory_get Max Chars
memoryGetMaxChars.description: Per-agent override for the default memory_get max character budget.

postCompactionMaxChars.title: Agent Post-compaction Max Chars
postCompactionMaxChars.description: Per-agent override for the post-compaction AGENTS.md excerpt budget.

contextLimits.title: Agent Context Limits
contextLimits.description: Optional per-agent overrides for the focused context budget knobs. Omitted fields inherit agents.defaults.contextLimits.

directPolicy.title: Heartbeat Direct Policy
directPolicy.description: Per-agent override for heartbeat direct/DM delivery policy; use "block" for agents that should only send heartbeat alerts to non-DM destinations.

timeoutSeconds.title: Heartbeat Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Per-agent maximum time in seconds allowed for a heartbeat agent turn before it is aborted. Leave unset to inherit the merged heartbeat timeout, then agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds when set, otherwise the heartbeat cadence capped at 600 seconds.

avatar.title: Identity Avatar
avatar.description: Agent avatar (workspace-relative path, http(s) URL, or data URI).

delegationMode.title: Sub-agent Delegation Mode
delegationMode.description: Per-agent override for sub-agent delegation strength. Omit to use "prefer" in this agent's main session and "suggest" elsewhere; explicit "prefer" or "suggest" always wins.

executionContract.title: Agent Embedded OpenClaw Execution Contract
executionContract.description: Optional per-agent embedded OpenClaw execution contract override. Set "strict-agentic" to enable structured plan tracking and non-visible turn recovery for that agent on supported OpenAI/OpenAI Codex GPT-5-family runs, or "default" to inherit the standard runner behavior.

embeddedAgent.title: Agent Embedded OpenClaw
embeddedAgent.description: Optional per-agent embedded OpenClaw overrides. Use this to opt specific agents into stricter GPT-5 execution behavior without changing the global default.

gpus.title: Agent Sandbox Docker GPUs
gpus.description: Per-agent Docker GPU passthrough override for sandbox containers.

dangerouslyAllowContainerNamespaceJoin.title: Agent Sandbox Docker Allow Container Namespace Join
dangerouslyAllowContainerNamespaceJoin.description: Per-agent DANGEROUS override for container namespace joins in sandbox Docker network mode.

network.title: Agent Sandbox Browser Network
network.description: Per-agent override for the sandbox browser Docker network. Use a bridge network; "none" is unsupported because browser control requires published CDP ports.

cdpSourceRange.title: Agent Sandbox Browser CDP Source Range
cdpSourceRange.description: Per-agent override for CDP source CIDR allowlist.

profile.title: Agent Tool Profile
profile.description: Per-agent override for tool profile selection when one agent needs a different capability baseline. Use this sparingly so policy differences across agents stay intentional and reviewable.

alsoAllow.title: Agent Tool Allowlist Additions
alsoAllow.description: Per-agent additive allowlist for tools on top of global and profile policy. Keep narrow to avoid accidental privilege expansion on specialized agents.

byProvider.title: Agent Tool Policy by Provider
byProvider.description: Per-agent provider-specific tool policy overrides for channel-scoped capability control. Use this when a single agent needs tighter restrictions on one provider than others.

codeMode.title: Agent Code Mode
codeMode.description: Per-agent Code Mode options. Explicit enabled overrides the shared model and global activation defaults; an agent-specific model codeMode override wins. Other options merge over tools.codeMode without changing activation.

swarm.title: Agent Swarm
swarm.description: Per-agent swarm override. Values merge over the top-level tools.swarm configuration.

github.title: Agent GitHub CLI Identity Override
github.description: Complete managed GitHub CLI identity and Git author override for this agent. Omit it to inherit the system identity.

allowWithinProvider.title: Agent Cross-Context Messaging (Same Provider)
allowWithinProvider.description: Per-agent message guard for sending to other conversations on the same provider. Set false for current-conversation-only public agents.

allowAcrossProviders.title: Agent Cross-Context Messaging (Across Providers)
allowAcrossProviders.description: Per-agent message guard for sending across providers. Keep false for public or sandboxed agents.

allow.title: Agent Message Action Allowlist
allow.description: Per-agent message action allowlist for the message tool. Set to a minimal list such as ["send"] for public sandbox agents so read, edit, delete, reaction, and other provider-specific message actions stay hidden and blocked.

type.title: Agent Runtime Type
type.description: Runtime type for this agent: "embedded" (default OpenClaw runtime) or "acp" (ACP harness defaults).

type.title: Agent Runtime Type
type.description: Runtime type for this agent: "embedded" (default OpenClaw runtime) or "acp" (ACP harness defaults).

agent.title: Agent ACP Harness Agent
agent.description: Optional ACP harness agent id to use for this OpenClaw agent (for example codex, claude, cursor, gemini, openclaw).

backend.title: Agent ACP Backend
backend.description: Optional ACP backend override for this agent's ACP sessions (falls back to global acp.backend).

mode.title: Agent ACP Mode
mode.description: Optional ACP session mode default for this agent (persistent or oneshot).

cwd.title: Agent ACP Working Directory
cwd.description: Optional default working directory for this agent's ACP sessions.

acp.title: Agent ACP Runtime
acp.description: ACP runtime defaults for this agent when runtime.type=acp. Binding-level ACP overrides still take precedence per conversation.

runtime.title: Agent Runtime
runtime.description: Optional runtime descriptor for this agent. Use embedded for default OpenClaw execution or acp for external ACP harness defaults.

entries.title: Agent List
entries.description: Explicit list of configured agents with IDs and optional overrides for model, tools, identity, and workspace. Keep IDs stable over time so bindings, approvals, and session routing remain deterministic.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agent runtime configuration root. Root siblings own infrastructure and cross-agent defaults; agents.defaults owns agent-loop behavior; agent entries may override either where supported.

worktreeRoot.title: Worktree Root
worktreeRoot.description: Global directory for new managed worktrees. Use an absolute path or ~ for your home directory; defaults to <state-dir>/worktrees. Existing worktrees keep their recorded paths when this changes.

profile.title: Tool Profile
profile.description: Global tool profile name used to select a predefined tool policy baseline before applying allow/deny overrides. Use this for consistent environment posture across agents and keep profile names stable.

allow.title: Tool Allowlist
allow.description: Absolute tool allowlist that replaces profile-derived defaults for strict environments. Use this only when you intentionally run a tightly curated subset of tool capabilities.

alsoAllow.title: Tool Allowlist Additions
alsoAllow.description: Extra tool allowlist entries merged on top of the selected tool profile and default policy. Keep this list small and explicit so audits can quickly identify intentional policy exceptions.

deny.title: Tool Denylist
deny.description: Global tool denylist that blocks listed tools even when profile or provider rules would allow them. Use deny rules for emergency lockouts and long-term defense-in-depth.

byProvider.title: Tool Policy by Provider
byProvider.description: Per-provider tool allow/deny overrides keyed by channel/provider ID to tailor capabilities by surface. Use this when one provider needs stricter controls than global tool policy.

enabled.title: Enable Web Search Tool
enabled.description: Enable managed web_search and optional Codex-native search for eligible models.

provider.title: Web Search Provider
provider.description: Search provider id. Auto-detected from available API keys if omitted.

timeoutSeconds.title: Web Search Timeout (sec)
timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for web_search requests.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Web Search Cache TTL (min)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Cache TTL in minutes for web_search results.
