target.description: Local service target forwarded by Tailscale Serve/Funnel (for example http://127.0.0.1:8787). Use explicit loopback targets to avoid ambiguous routing.

tailscale.title: Gmail Hook Tailscale
tailscale.description: Tailscale exposure configuration block for publishing Gmail callbacks through Serve/Funnel routes. Use private tailnet modes before enabling any public ingress path.

model.title: Gmail Hook Model Override
model.description: Optional model override for Gmail-triggered runs when mailbox automations should use dedicated model behavior. Keep unset to inherit agent defaults unless mailbox tasks need specialization.

thinking.title: Gmail Hook Thinking Override
thinking.description: Thinking effort override for Gmail-driven agent runs: "off", "minimal", "low", "medium", or "high". Keep modest defaults for routine inbox automations to control cost and latency.

gmail.title: Gmail Hook
gmail.description: Gmail push integration settings used for Pub/Sub notifications and optional local callback serving. Keep this scoped to dedicated Gmail automation accounts where possible.

enabled.title: Internal Hooks Enabled
enabled.description: Enables processing for internal hooks and configured entries in the internal hook runtime. Keep disabled unless internal hooks are intentionally configured.

entries.title: Internal Hook Entries
entries.description: Configured internal hook entry records used to register concrete runtime handlers and metadata. Keep entries explicit and versioned so production behavior is auditable.

extraDirs.title: Internal Hook Extra Directories
extraDirs.description: Additional directories searched for internal hook modules beyond default load paths. Keep this minimal and controlled to reduce accidental module shadowing.

load.title: Internal Hook Loader
load.description: Internal hook loader settings controlling where handler modules are discovered at startup. Use constrained load roots to reduce accidental module conflicts or shadowing.

internal.title: Internal Hooks
internal.description: Internal hook runtime settings for bundled/custom event handlers loaded from module paths. Use this for trusted in-process automations and keep handler loading tightly scoped.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Inbound webhook automation surface for mapping external events into wake or agent actions in OpenClaw. Keep this locked down with explicit token/session/agent controls before exposing it beyond trusted networks.

groupPolicy.title: Default Group Policy
groupPolicy.description: Default group policy across channels: "open", "disabled", or "allowlist". Keep "allowlist" for safer production setups unless broad group participation is intentional.

contextVisibility.title: Default Context Visibility
contextVisibility.description: Default supplemental context visibility for fetched quote/thread/history content: "all" (keep all context), "allowlist" (only allowlisted senders), or "allowlist_quote" (allowlist + keep explicit quotes).

showOk.title: Heartbeat Show OK
showOk.description: Shows healthy/OK heartbeat status entries when true in channel status outputs. Keep false in noisy environments and enable only when operators need explicit healthy confirmations.

showAlerts.title: Heartbeat Show Alerts
showAlerts.description: Shows degraded/error heartbeat alerts when true so operator channels surface problems promptly. Keep enabled in production so broken channel states are visible.

useIndicator.title: Heartbeat Use Indicator
useIndicator.description: Enables concise indicator-style heartbeat rendering instead of verbose status text where supported. Use indicator mode for dense dashboards with many active channels.

heartbeatVisibility.title: Default Heartbeat Visibility
heartbeatVisibility.description: Default heartbeat visibility settings for status messages emitted by providers/channels. Tune this globally to reduce noisy healthy-state updates while keeping alerts visible.

enabled.title: Default Bot Loop Protection Enabled
enabled.description: Enables pair loop protection by default for supporting channels when bot-authored messages can reach dispatch. Providers may still disable the guard when bots are ignored.

maxEventsPerWindow.title: Default Bot Loop Events per Window
maxEventsPerWindow.description: Maximum events a sender/receiver pair may exchange within the configured window before suppression starts. Default for supporting channels is 20.

windowSeconds.title: Default Bot Loop Window Seconds
windowSeconds.description: Sliding window length in seconds for pair loop budgets. Default for supporting channels is 60.

cooldownSeconds.title: Default Bot Loop Cooldown Seconds
cooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown seconds applied to a pair after it exceeds the loop budget. Default for supporting channels is 60.

botLoopProtection.title: Default Bot Loop Protection
botLoopProtection.description: Default pair loop protection settings for channel providers that support bot-to-bot loop guards. Use provider-specific overrides only when one channel needs a different budget.

replyToBot.title: Default Reply-to-Bot Implicit Mentions
replyToBot.description: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.

quotedBot.title: Default Quoted-Bot Implicit Mentions
quotedBot.description: Treat quoted bot messages as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.

threadParticipation.title: Default Thread-Participation Implicit Mentions
threadParticipation.description: Treat follow-ups in threads where the bot participated as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.

implicitMentions.title: Default Implicit Mentions
implicitMentions.description: Default policy for whether reply-to-bot, quoted-bot, and bot-participated-thread facts activate supporting message channels without an explicit mention.

defaults.title: Channel Defaults
defaults.description: Default channel behavior applied across providers when provider-specific settings are not set. Use this to enforce consistent baseline policy before per-provider tuning.

modelByChannel.title: Channel Model Overrides
modelByChannel.description: Map provider -> channel id / DM peer id -> model override (values are provider/model or aliases).

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel provider configurations plus shared defaults that control access policies, heartbeat visibility, and per-surface behavior. Keep defaults centralized and override per provider only where required.

domain.title: Wide-area Discovery Domain
domain.description: Optional unicast DNS-SD domain for wide-area discovery, such as openclaw.internal. Use this when you intentionally publish gateway discovery beyond local mDNS scopes.

wideArea.title: Wide-area Discovery
wideArea.description: Wide-area discovery configuration group for exposing discovery signals beyond local-link scopes. Enable only in deployments that intentionally aggregate gateway presence across sites.

mode.title: mDNS Discovery Mode
mode.description: mDNS broadcast mode ("minimal" default, "full" includes cliPath/sshPort, "off" disables mDNS).

mdns.title: mDNS Discovery
mdns.description: mDNS discovery configuration group for local network advertisement and discovery behavior tuning. Keep minimal mode for routine LAN discovery unless extra metadata is required.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Service discovery settings for local mDNS advertisement and optional wide-area presence signaling. Keep discovery scoped to expected networks to avoid leaking service metadata.

agentId.title: Talk Agent
agentId.description: Agent that owns Talk sessions created without an explicit agent-scoped session key.

apiKey.title: Talk Provider API Key
apiKey.description: Provider API key for Talk mode.

additionalProperties.title: Talk Provider Config
additionalProperties.description: Provider-owned Talk config fields for the matching provider id.

providers.title: Talk Provider Settings
providers.description: Provider-specific Talk settings keyed by provider id. During migration, prefer this over legacy talk.* keys.

provider.title: Talk Realtime Provider
provider.description: Active realtime voice provider id, such as openai or google.

apiKey.title: Talk Realtime Provider API Key
apiKey.description: Provider API key for realtime Talk.

additionalProperties.title: Talk Realtime Provider Config
additionalProperties.description: Provider-owned realtime voice config for the matching provider id.

providers.title: Talk Realtime Provider Settings
providers.description: Provider-specific realtime voice settings keyed by provider id.

model.title: Talk Realtime Model
model.description: Realtime provider model id override for browser or Gateway-owned Talk sessions.

speakerVoice.title: Talk Realtime Speaker Voice
speakerVoice.description: Realtime provider speaker voice name override for browser or Gateway-owned Talk sessions.

speakerVoiceId.title: Talk Realtime Speaker Voice ID
speakerVoiceId.description: Realtime provider speaker voice id override for browser or Gateway-owned Talk sessions.

instructions.title: Talk Realtime Instructions
instructions.description: Additional system instructions appended to OpenClaw's built-in realtime Talk prompt. Use this for voice style, tone, and other provider-facing realtime behavior while keeping agent-consult guidance intact.

mode.title: Talk Realtime Mode
mode.description: Talk execution mode: realtime, stt-tts, or transcription.

transport.title: Talk Realtime Transport
transport.description: Talk byte/session transport: webrtc, provider-websocket, gateway-relay, or managed-room.

vadThreshold.title: Talk Realtime VAD Threshold
vadThreshold.description: Realtime voice activity detection threshold from 0 (most sensitive) to 1 (least sensitive).

silenceDurationMs.title: Talk Realtime Silence Duration (ms)
silenceDurationMs.description: Milliseconds of silence before a realtime Talk user turn is committed.

prefixPaddingMs.title: Talk Realtime Prefix Padding (ms)
prefixPaddingMs.description: Milliseconds of audio retained before realtime voice activity is detected.

reasoningEffort.title: Talk Realtime Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: Provider-specific reasoning effort for realtime Talk sessions, such as minimal, low, medium, or high.

brain.title: Talk Realtime Brain
brain.description: Talk reasoning strategy: agent-consult for Gateway-mediated agent help, direct-tools for local tool calls, or none.

consultRouting.title: Talk Realtime Consult Routing
consultRouting.description: Gateway relay fallback for final user transcripts when the realtime provider skips openclaw_agent_consult. provider-direct preserves provider replies; force-agent-consult routes through OpenClaw.

realtime.title: Talk Realtime
realtime.description: Realtime Talk provider, model, voice, mode, transport, and brain strategy. Keep speech/TTS provider config in talk.provider and talk.providers.

consultThinkingLevel.title: Talk Consult Thinking Level
consultThinkingLevel.description: Use this to override the thinking level for the regular agent run behind Talk realtime consults.

consultFastMode.title: Talk Consult Fast Mode
consultFastMode.description: Use this to set true or false fast mode for the regular agent run behind Talk realtime consults.

speechLocale.title: Talk Speech Locale
speechLocale.description: BCP 47 locale id for Talk speech recognition on device nodes and the iOS system-voice fallback, for example "ru-RU". Leave unset to use each device default.

interruptOnSpeech.title: Talk Interrupt on Speech
interruptOnSpeech.description: If true (default), stop assistant speech when the user starts speaking in Talk mode. Keep enabled for conversational turn-taking.

silenceTimeoutMs.title: Talk Silence Timeout (ms)
silenceTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of user silence before Talk mode finalizes and sends the current transcript. Leave unset to keep the platform default pause window (700 ms on macOS and Android, 900 ms on iOS).

talk.title: Talk
talk.description: Talk-mode voice synthesis settings for voice identity, model selection, output format, and interruption behavior. Use this section to tune human-facing voice UX while controlling latency and cost.

port.title: Gateway Port
port.description: TCP port used by the gateway listener for API, control UI, and channel-facing ingress paths. Use a dedicated port and avoid collisions with reverse proxies or local developer services.

mode.title: Gateway Mode
mode.description: Gateway operation mode: "local" runs channels and agent runtime on this host, while "remote" connects through remote transport. Keep "local" unless you intentionally run a split remote gateway topology.

bind.title: Gateway Bind Mode
bind.description: Network bind profile: "auto", "lan", "loopback", "custom", or "tailnet" to control interface exposure. Keep "loopback" for local-only operation; "auto" can expose all interfaces.

customBindHost.title: Gateway Custom Bind Host
customBindHost.description: IPv4 address used for a custom bind. Specific IPv4s also require the same Gateway port on 127.0.0.1; avoid 0.0.0.0 unless all-interface exposure is required.

publicOrigin.title: Gateway Public Origin
publicOrigin.description: Externally reachable HTTPS origin of the Gateway. HTTP is allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]. Per-requester MCP OAuth uses it to build the callback URL at /oauth/mcp/callback; channel session links and plugin-generated viewer links use it to reach the Control UI and Gateway routes.

enabled.title: Control UI Enabled
enabled.description: Enables serving the gateway Control UI from the gateway HTTP process when true. Keep enabled for local administration, and disable when an external control surface replaces it.

basePath.title: Control UI Base Path
basePath.description: Optional URL prefix where the Control UI is served (e.g. /openclaw).

customPlugins.title: Custom Plugin UI
customPlugins.description: Allow user-installed plugins to execute native JavaScript in the Control UI (default: false). Bundled plugin views remain available. Custom UI shares the signed-in operator's Gateway permissions; enable only for trusted plugins. Restart the Gateway and reload open Control UI pages after changing this setting.

experimental.title: Experimental Control UI Features
experimental.description: Opt-in Control UI experiments. These capabilities may change between releases and remain disabled unless explicitly enabled.

root.title: Control UI Assets Root
root.description: Optional filesystem root for Control UI assets (defaults to dist/control-ui).

label.title: Control UI Environment Label
label.description: Environment label displayed in the Control UI and browser tab; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and the label must contain 1 to 24 characters.

color.title: Control UI Environment Color
color.description: Named environment color ramp: teal, amber, purple, coral, pink, blue, green, red, or gray.

environment.title: Control UI Environment
environment.description: Optional public environment identity shown in the Control UI stripe, agent avatar, label pills, browser title, and favicon. Omit it to preserve the default appearance.

communityInvite.title: Control UI Community Invitation
communityInvite.description: Show the Discord community invitation in the Control UI served by this Gateway (default on). Set false to hide it for every browser using this UI deployment. Changes apply after browser refresh or reconnect; re-enabling preserves browser-local dismissals.

token.title: Control UI GitHub Service Credential
token.description: SecretRef-backed service credential for Control UI project discovery and GitHub hover previews without a managed identity. Hover previews prefer the selected agent's configured GitHub identity, inheriting the system identity when there is no override. Prefer explicit configuration for clear service ownership. Omit it to retain the GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN fallback from the shared Gateway process environment. An explicitly configured but unavailable credential fails closed.

sessionObserver.title: Control UI Session Observer
sessionObserver.description: Produce live session status digests for subscribed Control UI clients with each agent's utility model (default on). Set false to disable observer model calls gateway-wide; setting agents.defaults.utilityModel to an empty string disables utility-model observation for agents that do not override it.

embedSandbox.title: Control UI Embed Sandbox Mode
embedSandbox.description: Iframe sandbox policy for hosted Control UI embeds. "strict" disables scripts, "scripts" allows interactive embeds while keeping origin isolation (default), and "trusted" adds `allow-same-origin` for same-site documents that intentionally need stronger privileges.

allowExternalEmbedUrls.title: Allow External Control UI Embed URLs
allowExternalEmbedUrls.description: DANGEROUS toggle that allows hosted embeds to load absolute external http(s) URLs. Keep this off unless your Control UI intentionally embeds trusted third-party pages; hosted /__openclaw__/canvas and /__openclaw__/a2ui documents do not need it.

automaticallyFetchFavicons.title: Automatically Fetch Link Favicons
automaticallyFetchFavicons.description: Fetch link favicons through the Gateway (default on). The Gateway requests only HTTPS /favicon.ico from public destinations, applies strict SSRF checks to every DNS result and redirect, and validates bounded image bytes. Set false to prevent all favicon route requests and destination fetches.

allowedOrigins.title: Control UI Allowed Origins
allowedOrigins.description: Allowed browser origins for Control UI/WebChat websocket connections (full origins only, e.g. https://control.example.com). Required for non-loopback Control UI deployments unless dangerous Host-header fallback is explicitly enabled. Setting ["*"] means allow any browser origin and should be avoided outside tightly controlled local testing.

dangerouslyAllowHostHeaderOriginFallback.title: Dangerously Allow Host-Header Origin Fallback
dangerouslyAllowHostHeaderOriginFallback.description: DANGEROUS toggle that enables Host-header based origin fallback for Control UI/WebChat websocket checks. This mode is supported when your deployment intentionally relies on Host-header origin policy; explicit gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins remains the recommended hardened default.

controlUi.title: Control UI
controlUi.description: Control UI hosting settings including enablement, pathing, and browser-origin/auth hardening behavior. Keep UI exposure minimal and pair with strong auth controls before internet-facing deployments.

enabled.title: CLI Agents Enabled
enabled.description: Shows catalog-backed CLI agents in the Control UI new-session model picker when true (default: true). Set false to disable CLI agents and native CLI session creation. Only catalogs that advertise session creation are listed, and the picker stays hidden when the Gateway does not advertise session catalog support.

cliAgents.title: CLI Agents
cliAgents.description: Experimental Control UI discovery for external CLI session engines exposed by the Gateway session catalog. Enabled by default; disable to prevent starting those engines from the new-session model picker.

enabled.title: Operator Terminal Enabled
enabled.description: Enables the operator terminal for admin-scope clients (default: true). This exposes a browser/mobile shell with the gateway process environment; set false to opt out on deployments where admin operators should not get a host shell. Changing this restarts the gateway so connected clients reload with the correct terminal availability and content-security policy.

shell.title: Operator Terminal Shell
shell.description: Shell executable the operator terminal launches. Leave unset to use the host login shell ($SHELL on Unix, %ComSpec% on Windows), or pin an explicit interpreter for a consistent operator environment.

detachedSessionTimeoutSeconds.title: Operator Terminal Detached Session Timeout
detachedSessionTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a terminal session survives after its connection drops (laptop sleep, page reload), staying reattachable via terminal.attach with its recent output replayed. Set 0 to kill sessions the moment the connection drops. Default: 300 (5 minutes). Detached sessions keep running their commands, so shorten this on shared or exposed hosts.

terminal.title: Operator Terminal
terminal.description: Operator terminal served to Control UI and mobile clients: a PTY-backed shell on the gateway host, restricted to admin-scope operator sessions. It starts in the target agent's workspace and is refused for fully-sandboxed agents (sandbox.mode 'all') rather than handing back an unconfined host shell.

mode.title: Gateway Auth Mode
mode.description: Gateway auth mode: "none", "token", "password", or "trusted-proxy" depending on your edge architecture. Token/password mode selects the configured secret (gateway.auth.token or gateway.auth.password); clients may send it in either connect auth field. Use token/password for direct exposure, and trusted-proxy only behind hardened identity-aware proxies.

token.title: Gateway Token
token.description: Shared secret selected by gateway.auth.mode=token, the default for new local onboarding. Clients may send it in either auth.token or auth.password. Non-loopback binds require an enabled authentication mode.

password.title: Gateway Password
password.description: Shared secret selected by gateway.auth.mode=password. Clients may send it in either auth.token or auth.password. Password mode is required for Tailscale Funnel.

allowTailscale.title: Gateway Auth Allow Tailscale Identity
allowTailscale.description: Allows trusted Tailscale identity paths to satisfy gateway auth checks when configured. Use this only when your tailnet identity posture is strong and operator workflows depend on it.

identityScopes.title: Gateway Identity Scope Grants
identityScopes.description: Maps verified trusted-proxy or Tailscale identities to connection-only operator scope grants. Email keys match case-insensitively; grants augment device scopes before the connection scope cap is applied.

rateLimit.title: Gateway Auth Rate Limit
rateLimit.description: Login/auth attempt throttling controls to reduce credential brute-force risk at the gateway boundary. Keep enabled in exposed environments and tune thresholds to your traffic baseline.

enabled.title: Trusted Proxy Device Auto-Approval Enabled
enabled.description: Automatically approves new browser and native UI operator devices and same-key scope upgrades after the reverse proxy authenticates an allowed user. Default: false. Enable only when the proxy identity boundary is strong enough to replace manual device pairing.

scopes.title: Trusted Proxy Device Auto-Approval Scopes
scopes.description: Maximum scopes granted to auto-approved operator devices. Defaults to operator.read, operator.write, operator.approvals, and operator.questions. Requested scopes are capped to this list; requests without scopes receive this list. When unset, auto-approval also adds operator.questions for older UI clients; an explicit list is never widened. Explicitly listing operator.admin lets every proxy-authenticated user auto-approve full admin and makes scope-less requests receive full admin automatically; it also triggers a critical security audit finding and Gateway startup warning.

deviceAutoApprove.title: Trusted Proxy Device Auto-Approval
deviceAutoApprove.description: Optional policy for automatically approving new browser and native UI operator devices and same-key scope upgrades after trusted-proxy authentication. Grants are capped by deviceAutoApprove.scopes and the proxy's x-openclaw-scopes header when present.

trustedProxy.title: Gateway Trusted Proxy Auth
trustedProxy.description: Trusted-proxy auth header mapping for upstream identity providers that inject user claims. Use only with known proxy CIDRs and strict header allowlists to prevent spoofed identity headers.

auth.title: Gateway Auth
auth.description: Authentication policy for gateway HTTP/WebSocket access including mode, credentials, trusted-proxy behavior, and rate limiting. Keep auth enabled for every non-loopback deployment.

default.title: Default Operator Role
default.description: Required role assigned to authenticated profiles without a valid explicit assignment whenever operator roles are configured. Its name must match a configured role definition.

others.title: Operator Role Access to Other Sessions
others.description: Access to other people's sessions: "none" hides them, "view" allows reading, "suggest" permits the suggestion flow, and "write" permits participation. Explicit session membership can grant additional access.

sessions.title: Operator Role Session Access
sessions.description: Session-sharing permissions granted to this role for sessions created by other authenticated people; a person's own sessions remain owner-accessible.

sandbox.title: Operator Role Sandbox Isolation
sandbox.description: Execution isolation for newly created sessions: "inherit" (default) uses the agent policy; "required" permanently requires a sandbox, even when the agent sandbox mode is off, and fails closed if the backend is unavailable.

agents.title: Operator Role Allowed Agents
agents.description: Agents available when this role creates sessions or starts runs: set "*" to allow every agent, list agent IDs to allow only those agents, or use an empty list to disable both.

scopes.title: Operator Role Scope Ceiling
scopes.description: Closed list of operator scopes granted as this role's maximum connection authority. Requested, paired, identity-granted, and upgraded scopes are intersected with this list.

additionalProperties.title: Operator Role Definition
additionalProperties.description: One named operator role. Every definition must explicitly provide its session-sharing policy, allowed session and run agents, and operator-scope ceiling, and can require sandbox isolation for newly created sessions.

definitions.title: Operator Role Definitions
definitions.description: Nonempty administrator-named role definitions bundling the closed session-sharing, sandbox-isolation, agent-access, and operator-scope policies applied to authenticated user profiles.

roles.title: Gateway Operator Roles
roles.description: Optional profile-bound operator roles for team Gateways. Each named role controls access to other people's sessions, sandbox isolation, session and run agents, and granted operator scopes; omitting this section preserves existing operator behavior.

trustedProxies.title: Gateway Trusted Proxy CIDRs
trustedProxies.description: CIDR/IP allowlist of upstream proxies permitted to provide forwarded client identity headers. Keep this list narrow so untrusted hops cannot impersonate users.

allowRealIpFallback.title: Gateway Allow x-real-ip Fallback
allowRealIpFallback.description: Enables x-real-ip fallback when x-forwarded-for is missing in proxy scenarios. Keep disabled unless your ingress stack requires this compatibility behavior.

deny.title: Gateway Tool Denylist
deny.description: Explicit gateway-level tool denylist to block risky tools even if lower-level policies allow them. Use deny rules for emergency response and defense-in-depth hardening.

allow.title: Gateway Tool Allowlist
allow.description: Explicit gateway-level tool allowlist when you want a narrow set of tools available at runtime. Use this for locked-down environments where tool scope must be tightly controlled.

tools.title: Gateway Tool Exposure Policy
tools.description: Gateway-level tool exposure allow/deny policy that can restrict runtime tool availability independent of agent/tool profiles. Use this for coarse emergency controls and production hardening.

mode.title: Gateway Tailscale Mode
mode.description: Tailscale publish mode: "off", "serve", or "funnel" for private or public exposure paths. Use "serve" for tailnet-only access and "funnel" only when public internet reachability is required.

preserveFunnel.title: Gateway Tailscale External Funnel Migration Guard
preserveFunnel.description: Deprecated migration guard for mode='serve'. If an external Funnel still targets the ordinary Gateway listener, OpenClaw leaves exposure unchanged and warns that only plugin-authenticated webhooks remain usable until password auth is configured and mode is migrated to 'funnel'.

tailscale.title: Gateway Tailscale
tailscale.description: Tailscale integration settings for Serve/Funnel exposure and lifecycle handling on gateway start/exit. Keep off unless your deployment intentionally relies on Tailscale ingress.

url.title: Remote Gateway URL
url.description: Remote Gateway WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://).

transport.title: Remote Gateway Transport
transport.description: Remote connection transport: "direct" uses configured URL connectivity, while "ssh" tunnels through SSH. Use SSH when you need encrypted tunnel semantics without exposing remote ports.

token.title: Remote Gateway Token
token.description: Shared secret sent in the token field to authenticate this client to a remote gateway. The server's gateway.auth.mode selects its configured secret; either client token or password field is accepted. Store via secret/env substitution and rotate alongside remote gateway auth changes.

password.title: Remote Gateway Password
password.description: Shared secret sent in the password field to authenticate this client to a remote gateway. The server's gateway.auth.mode selects its configured secret; either client token or password field is accepted. Keep this secret managed externally and avoid plaintext values in committed config.

edgeAuth.title: Remote Gateway Edge Auth Headers
edgeAuth.description: Secret-backed HTTP headers presented to an identity-aware proxy in front of the configured remote Gateway. Headers are sent only to the exact gateway.remote.url origin over WSS and never follow redirects.

tlsFingerprint.title: Remote Gateway TLS Fingerprint
tlsFingerprint.description: Expected sha256 TLS fingerprint for the remote gateway (pin to avoid MITM).

sshTarget.title: Remote Gateway SSH Target
sshTarget.description: Remote gateway over SSH (tunnels the gateway port to localhost). Format: user@host or user@host:port.

sshIdentity.title: Remote Gateway SSH Identity
sshIdentity.description: Optional SSH identity file path (passed to ssh -i).

sshHostKeyPolicy.title: Remote Gateway SSH Host-Key Policy
sshHostKeyPolicy.description: macOS SSH host-key verification policy. "strict" requires an already trusted host key; "openssh" explicitly delegates to effective OpenSSH configuration.

remote.title: Remote Gateway
remote.description: Remote gateway connection settings for direct or SSH transport when this instance proxies to another runtime host. Use remote mode only when split-host operation is intentionally configured.

mode.title: Config Reload Mode
mode.description: Controls how config edits are applied: "off" ignores live edits and "hybrid" applies hot-safe changes then restarts when required.

reload.title: Config Reload
reload.description: Live config-reload policy for how edits are applied and when full restarts are triggered. Keep hybrid behavior for safest operational updates unless debugging reload internals.

enabled.title: Gateway TLS Enabled
enabled.description: Enables TLS termination at the gateway listener so clients connect over HTTPS/WSS directly. Keep enabled for direct internet exposure or any untrusted network boundary.

autoGenerate.title: Gateway TLS Auto-Generate Cert
autoGenerate.description: Auto-generates a local TLS certificate/key pair when explicit files are not configured. Use only for local/dev setups and replace with real certificates for production traffic.

certPath.title: Gateway TLS Certificate Path
certPath.description: Filesystem path to the TLS certificate file used by the gateway when TLS is enabled. Use managed certificate paths and keep renewal automation aligned with this location.

keyPath.title: Gateway TLS Key Path
keyPath.description: Filesystem path to the TLS private key file used by the gateway when TLS is enabled. Keep this key file permission-restricted and rotate per your security policy.

caPath.title: Gateway TLS CA Path
caPath.description: Optional CA bundle path for client verification or custom trust-chain requirements at the gateway edge. Use this when private PKI or custom certificate chains are part of deployment.

tls.title: Gateway TLS
tls.description: TLS certificate and key settings for terminating HTTPS directly in the gateway process. Use explicit certificates in production and avoid plaintext exposure on untrusted networks.

enabled.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Endpoint
enabled.description: Enable the OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/chat/completions` endpoint (default: false).

allowUrl.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Allow Image URLs
allowUrl.description: Allow server-side URL fetches for `image_url` parts (default: false; data URIs remain supported). Set this to `false` to disable URL fetching entirely.

urlAllowlist.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image URL Allowlist
urlAllowlist.description: Optional hostname allowlist for `image_url` URL fetches; supports exact hosts and `*.example.com` wildcards. Empty or omitted lists mean no hostname allowlist restriction.

allowedMimes.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image MIME Allowlist
allowedMimes.description: Allowed MIME types for `image_url` parts (case-insensitive list).

maxBytes.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image Max Bytes

maxRedirects.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image Max Redirects
maxRedirects.description: Max HTTP redirects allowed when fetching `image_url` URLs (default: 3).

timeoutMs.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for `image_url` URL fetches (default: 10000).

images.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Image Limits
images.description: Image fetch/validation controls for OpenAI-compatible `image_url` parts.

endpoints.title: Gateway HTTP Endpoints
endpoints.description: HTTP endpoint feature toggles under the gateway API surface for compatibility routes and optional integrations. Enable endpoints intentionally and monitor access patterns after rollout.

strictTransportSecurity.title: Strict Transport Security Header
strictTransportSecurity.description: Value for the Strict-Transport-Security response header. Set only on HTTPS origins that you fully control; use false to explicitly disable.

securityHeaders.title: Gateway HTTP Security Headers
securityHeaders.description: Optional HTTP response security headers applied by the gateway process itself. Prefer setting these at your reverse proxy when TLS terminates there.

http.title: Gateway HTTP API
http.description: Gateway HTTP API configuration grouping endpoint toggles and transport-facing API exposure controls. Keep only required endpoints enabled to reduce attack surface.

baseUrl.title: Gateway APNs Relay Base URL
baseUrl.description: Optional custom base HTTPS URL for the external APNs relay service used by official App Store iOS builds. Keep this aligned with the relay URL baked into the iOS build so registration and send traffic hit the same deployment.

timeoutMs.title: Gateway APNs Relay Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for relay send requests from the gateway to the APNs relay (default: 10000). Increase for slower relays or networks, or lower to fail wake attempts faster.

relay.title: Gateway APNs Relay
relay.description: External relay settings for relay-backed APNs sends. The gateway uses the hosted OpenClaw relay by default, or this custom relay for push.test, wake nudges, and reconnect wakes after a paired official iOS build publishes a relay-backed registration.

apns.title: Gateway APNs Delivery
apns.description: APNs delivery settings for iOS devices paired to this gateway. Use relay settings for official App Store builds that register through the external push relay.

push.title: Gateway Push Delivery
push.description: Push-delivery settings used by the gateway when it needs to wake or notify paired devices. Configure relay-backed APNs here for official iOS builds; direct APNs auth remains env-based for local/manual builds.

mode.title: Gateway Node Browser Mode
mode.description: Node browser routing ("auto" = pick single connected browser node, "manual" = require node param, "off" = disable).

node.title: Gateway Node Browser Pin
node.description: Pin browser routing to a specific node id or name (optional).

autoApproveLocal.title: Gateway Node Pairing Auto-Approve Local
autoApproveLocal.description: Silently approve trusted local pairing and access upgrades (default: true); set false to trade convenience for explicit approval of every device.

autoApproveCidrs.title: Gateway Node Pairing Auto-Approve CIDRs
autoApproveCidrs.description: Opt-in CIDR/IP allowlist for auto-approving first-time node-role device pairing with no requested scopes. Disabled when unset. Operator, browser, Control UI, and any role, scope, metadata, or public-key upgrade pairing still require manual approval.

sshVerify.title: Gateway Node Pairing SSH Verification
sshVerify.description: SSH-verified auto-approval for first-time node-role device pairing (default: enabled). The gateway SSHes back to the pairing host (BatchMode, strict host keys) and approves only when the remote `openclaw node identity` output matches the pending device key. Set false to disable SSH verification (independent of autoApproveCidrs, which stays active); for manual-only pairing also unset autoApproveCidrs. Pass an object to override user/identity/timeoutMs/cidrs.

pairing.title: Gateway Node Pairing
pairing.description: Node pairing policy settings. SSH-verified auto-approval is enabled by default; CIDR auto-approval stays disabled unless explicit trusted CIDR/IP allowlists are configured.

enabled.title: Gateway Node Plugin Tools Enabled
enabled.description: Accept agent-visible plugin tool descriptors published by paired nodes (default: true). Set false to ignore and remove all node-published plugin tools.

pluginTools.title: Gateway Node Plugin Tools
pluginTools.description: Controls whether paired nodes may publish agent-visible plugin tool descriptors.

allowSkills.title: Gateway Node Skills Enabled
allowSkills.description: Accept skills published by paired nodes while they are connected (default: true). Set false to ignore node-published skills.

allow.title: Gateway Node Allowlist (Extra Commands)
allow.description: Extra node.invoke commands to allow beyond the gateway defaults (array of command strings). Enabling dangerous commands here is a security-sensitive override and is flagged by `openclaw security audit`.

deny.title: Gateway Node Denylist
deny.description: Node command names to block even if present in node claims or default allowlist (exact command-name matching only, e.g. `system.run`; does not inspect shell text inside that command).

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: Gateway runtime surface for bind mode, auth, control UI, remote transport, and operational safety controls. Keep conservative defaults unless you intentionally expose the gateway beyond trusted local interfaces.

desktop.title: Cloud Worker Desktop (Labs)
desktop.description: Enables the experimental worker.desktop.observe surface and Control UI Desktop panel for desktop-capable cloud worker environments.

additionalProperties.title: Cloud Worker Project Profile
additionalProperties.description: Cloud worker profile name used by default when a session worktree's origin matches this repository identity.

projectProfiles.title: Cloud Worker Project Profiles
projectProfiles.description: Default cloud worker profile names keyed by normalized lowercase repository identity (host/owner/repo). Explicit dispatch profile ids take precedence.

provider.title: Cloud Worker Provider
provider.description: Worker provider id registered by a plugin. The configured plugin must expose this id before the gateway can provision environments from the profile.

install.title: Cloud Worker Install Method
install.description: Worker installation method: "bundle" (default) transfers the gateway's content-hashed installed build and supports released, development, and unreleased versions; "npm" installs the exact gateway version and is available only when that version is released.

suspendAfter.title: Cloud Worker Idle Suspend Duration
suspendAfter.description: Automatically reclaims an idle cloud worker after this duration, such as 45m or 2h; the next message provisions a replacement. Minimum: 1m. Leave unset to keep workers running.

settings.title: Cloud Worker Provider Settings
settings.description: Provider-owned settings validated by the selected plugin. Use SecretRef objects for secret-bearing values; opaque settings do not gain automatic secret resolution.

additionalProperties.title: Cloud Worker Profile
additionalProperties.description: One cloud worker profile selected by name when creating an environment. Keep provider credentials in supported references rather than embedding secret material in this block.

profiles.title: Cloud Worker Profiles
profiles.description: Named cloud worker profiles. Each profile selects a worker provider registered by a plugin and carries provider-owned settings.

cloudWorkers.title: Cloud Workers
cloudWorkers.description: Opt-in cloud worker profiles for disposable remote environments. When this section is omitted or has no profiles, cloud worker creation remains unavailable and existing gateway/node status behavior is unchanged.

enabled.title: Gateway Host Desktop (Labs)
enabled.description: Enables the experimental gateway-host desktop source. Restart the gateway after changing this setting.

managed.title: Managed Linux Host Desktop
managed.description: Runs and supervises a loopback-only headless TigerVNC/XFCE desktop on Linux. An explicit port or existing default-port VNC server still takes precedence.

port.title: Gateway Host VNC Port
port.description: Loopback RFB port of an already-running VNC server on the gateway host (default: 5900).

passwordFile.title: Gateway Host VNC Password File
passwordFile.description: Absolute path to the VNC password file. Omit on macOS to use account/ARD authentication after that support lands.

host.title: Gateway Host Desktop
host.description: Experimental gateway-host desktop observation backed by an existing or managed loopback VNC server.

citations.title: Memory Citations Mode
citations.description: Controls citation visibility in replies: "auto" shows citations when useful, "on" always shows them, and "off" hides them. Keep "auto" for a balanced signal-to-noise default.

enabled.title: Enable Memory Search
enabled.description: Master toggle for memory search indexing and retrieval behavior on this agent profile. Keep enabled for semantic recall, and disable when you want fully stateless responses.

rememberAcrossConversations.title: Remember Across Conversations
rememberAcrossConversations.description: Use relevant context from this agent's other private conversations through protected transcript recall. Defaults on only when global session.dmScope is unset or "main" and no binding overrides DM scope; any configured DM isolation defaults it off. An explicit true or false always wins.

sources.title: Memory Search Sources
sources.description: Chooses which sources are indexed: "memory" reads MEMORY.md + memory files, and "sessions" includes transcript history. Keep ["memory"] unless you need recall from prior chat transcripts.

path.title: Extra Memory Path
path.description: Sets the extra memory directory or file. Relative paths resolve from the agent workspace; direct file entries are indexed exactly.

pattern.title: Extra Memory Path Pattern
pattern.description: Limits a directory entry to supported files matching this root-relative glob, for example "runbooks/**/*.md". Omit it to scan all supported files recursively.

extraPaths.title: Extra Memory Paths
extraPaths.description: Adds extra directories or .md files to the memory index beyond default memory files. Entries may be path strings or objects with a root-relative glob pattern. When multimodal memory is enabled, matching image/audio files under these paths are also eligible for indexing.

enabled.title: Enable Memory Search Multimodal
enabled.description: Enables image/audio memory indexing from extraPaths. This currently requires Gemini embedding-2, keeps the default memory roots Markdown-only, disables memory-search fallback providers, and uploads matching binary content to the configured remote embedding provider.

modalities.title: Memory Search Multimodal Modalities
modalities.description: Selects which multimodal file types are indexed from extraPaths: "image", "audio", or "all". Keep this narrow to avoid indexing large binary corpora unintentionally.

maxFileBytes.title: Memory Search Multimodal Max File Bytes
maxFileBytes.description: Sets the maximum bytes allowed per multimodal file before it is skipped during memory indexing. Use this to cap upload cost and indexing latency, or raise it for short high-quality audio clips.

multimodal.title: Memory Search Multimodal
multimodal.description: Optional multimodal memory settings for indexing image and audio files from configured extra paths. Keep this off unless your embedding model explicitly supports cross-modal embeddings, and set `memory.search.fallback` to "none" while it is enabled. Matching files are uploaded to the configured remote embedding provider during indexing.

sessionMemory.title: Memory Search Session Index (Experimental)
sessionMemory.description: Indexes session transcripts into memory search. Keep this advanced override when root and per-agent recall inheritance differ.

provider.title: Memory Search Provider
provider.description: Selects the embedding backend used to build/query memory vectors. Defaults to "openai"; set "openai-compatible", "gemini", "voyage", "mistral", "bedrock", "deepinfra", "github-copilot", "lmstudio", "ollama", or "local" when you want a different backend.

baseUrl.title: Remote Embedding Base URL
baseUrl.description: Overrides the embedding API endpoint, such as an OpenAI-compatible proxy or custom Gemini base URL. Use this only when routing through your own gateway or vendor endpoint; keep provider defaults otherwise.

apiKey.title: Remote Embedding API Key
apiKey.description: Supplies a dedicated API key for remote embedding calls used by memory indexing and query-time embeddings. Use this when memory embeddings should use different credentials than global defaults or environment variables.

headers.title: Remote Embedding Headers
headers.description: Adds custom HTTP headers to remote embedding requests, merged with provider defaults. Use this for proxy auth and tenant routing headers, and keep values minimal to avoid leaking sensitive metadata.

enabled.title: Remote Batch Embedding Enabled
enabled.description: Enables provider batch APIs for embedding jobs when supported (OpenAI/Gemini), improving throughput on larger index runs. Keep this enabled unless debugging provider batch failures or running very small workloads.

fallback.title: Memory Search Fallback
fallback.description: Backup provider used when primary embeddings fail: "openai", "gemini", "voyage", "mistral", "bedrock", "lmstudio", "ollama", "local", or "none". Set a real fallback for production reliability; use "none" only if you prefer explicit failures.

model.title: Memory Search Model
model.description: Embedding model override used by the selected memory provider when a non-default model is required. Set this only when you need explicit recall quality/cost tuning beyond provider defaults.

inputType.title: Memory Search Input Type
inputType.description: Use this optional provider-specific `input_type` value only when the same label should apply to both query and document embedding requests. For asymmetric providers, prefer queryInputType and documentInputType.

queryInputType.title: Memory Search Query Input Type
queryInputType.description: Optional provider-specific `input_type` value for query-time memory embeddings. Use this with OpenAI-compatible asymmetric embedding endpoints that require a query label.

documentInputType.title: Memory Search Document Input Type
documentInputType.description: Optional provider-specific `input_type` value for document and indexing memory embeddings. Use this with OpenAI-compatible asymmetric embedding endpoints that require a passage or document label.

outputDimensionality.title: Memory Search Output Dimensionality
outputDimensionality.description: Provider-specific output vector size override for memory embeddings. Gemini models support 128-3072 dimensions and recommend 768, 1536, or 3072; Bedrock families such as Titan V2, Cohere V4, and Nova expose their own allowed sizes. Expect a full reindex when you change it because stored vector dimensions must stay consistent.

modelPath.title: Local Embedding Model Path
modelPath.description: Specifies the local embedding model source for local memory search, such as a GGUF file path or `hf:` URI. Use this only when provider is `local`, and verify model compatibility before large index rebuilds.

enabled.title: Memory Search Vector Index
enabled.description: Controls the sqlite-vec semantic index. Keep this advanced override when root and per-agent vector policies differ.

extensionPath.title: Memory Search Vector Extension Path
extensionPath.description: Overrides the auto-discovered sqlite-vec extension library path (`.dylib`, `.so`, or `.dll`). Use this when your runtime cannot find sqlite-vec automatically or you pin a known-good build.

maxResults.title: Memory Search Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of memory hits returned from search before downstream reranking and prompt injection. Raise for broader recall, or lower for tighter prompts and faster responses.

minScore.title: Memory Search Min Score
minScore.description: Minimum relevance score threshold for including memory results in final recall output. Increase to reduce weak/noisy matches, or lower when you need more permissive retrieval.

enabled.title: Memory Search Embedding Cache
enabled.description: Caches computed chunk embeddings in SQLite so reindexing and incremental updates run faster (default: true). Keep this enabled unless investigating cache correctness or minimizing disk usage.

search.title: Memory Search
search.description: Vector search over MEMORY.md and memory/*.md (per-agent overrides supported).

sessionIdleTtlMs.title: MCP Session Idle TTL (ms)
sessionIdleTtlMs.description: Optional idle eviction for OpenClaw session MCP runtimes in milliseconds. Unset or 0 keeps runtimes alive until session cleanup or Gateway shutdown. Positive values round down; active leases and pending acquisitions prevent eviction. Run-owned runtimes still retire when their one-shot run ends.

identity.title: MCP OAuth Identity
identity.description: OAuth credential ownership for this server. Omit this field or use "shared" for operator-managed credentials; use "per-requester" to let each authenticated sender connect their own account.

authProfileId.title: MCP OAuth Auth Profile
authProfileId.description: Refresh-capable auth profile id used to inject the current bearer token into this remote MCP server. When set, OpenClaw resolves and refreshes the profile at runtime and does not project refresh material downstream.

include.title: Included MCP Tools
include.description: Exact MCP tool names or simple '*' globs to expose from this server. When omitted, all server tools remain eligible unless excluded.

exclude.title: Excluded MCP Tools
exclude.description: Exact MCP tool names or simple '*' globs to hide from this server.

toolFilter.title: MCP Tool Selection
toolFilter.description: Per-server MCP tool selection. Use include to expose only selected MCP tool names, or exclude to hide selected MCP tool names. Entries accept exact names and simple '*' globs.

agents.title: Codex MCP Agents
agents.description: Optional non-empty OpenClaw agent ids that should receive this MCP server in Codex app-server thread config. Empty, blank, or invalid lists fail closed; when omitted, the server is projected for all Codex app-server agents.

defaultToolsApprovalMode.title: Codex MCP Tool Approval
defaultToolsApprovalMode.description: Optional Codex MCP tool approval mode for this server: "auto", "prompt", or "approve". Use only for MCP servers you intentionally trust.

codex.title: Codex MCP Projection
codex.description: OpenClaw projection metadata for Codex app-server threads only. It does not affect ACP sessions or generic Codex harness config. Omit this block to keep the server available to every Codex app-server agent with Codex's default MCP approval behavior.

servers.title: MCP Servers
servers.description: Named MCP server definitions. OpenClaw stores them in its own config and runtime adapters decide which transports are supported at execution time.

enabled.title: MCP Apps Enabled
enabled.description: Opt-in MCP Apps rendering and app-to-server bridge. Keep disabled unless you trust the configured MCP servers that provide app UI resources.

sandboxOrigin.title: MCP Apps Sandbox Origin
sandboxOrigin.description: Optional dedicated public HTTP(S) origin for MCP Apps. Use this behind a reverse proxy or TLS terminator and proxy it only to the configured MCP Apps sandbox port. It must differ from the Control UI origin and must not serve authenticated content.

sandboxPort.title: MCP Apps Sandbox Port
sandboxPort.description: Dedicated MCP Apps sandbox listener port. Defaults to the Gateway port plus one. Set an unused port when another local service or Gateway profile already owns that port.

apps.title: MCP Apps
apps.description: MCP Apps UI support. When enabled, configured MCP servers may provide interactive HTML views for their tool results.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Global MCP server definitions managed by OpenClaw. Embedded OpenClaw and other runtime adapters can consume these servers without storing them inside runtime-owned project settings.

extraDirs.title: Extra Skill Directories
extraDirs.description: Additional shared skill roots to scan at lowest precedence. Use this for sibling repos or shared skill packs that should be available without copying them into the OpenClaw workspace.

allowSymlinkTargets.title: Allowed Skill Symlink Targets
allowSymlinkTargets.description: Trusted real target roots that skill symlinks may resolve into when they sit outside their configured source root. Keep this narrow, such as a sibling repo skills directory.

watch.title: Watch Skills
watch.description: Enable filesystem watching for skill-definition changes so updates can be applied without full process restart. Keep enabled in development workflows and disable in immutable production images.

mode.title: Skill Workshop Autonomous Mode
mode.description: Controls background learning: "off" keeps only the suggestion nudge, "propose" creates pending proposals, and "auto" applies captured proposals and runs weekly review of Workshop-owned skills using ordinary file edits. Default: "auto".

enabled.title: Enable Plugins
enabled.description: Enable or disable plugin/extension loading globally during startup and config reload (default: true). Keep enabled only when extension capabilities are required by your deployment.

allow.title: Plugin Allowlist
allow.description: Optional allowlist of plugin IDs; when set, only listed plugins are eligible to load. Configured bundled chat channels can still activate their bundled plugin when the channel is explicitly enabled in config. Use this to enforce approved extension inventories in controlled environments.

deny.title: Plugin Denylist
deny.description: Optional denylist of plugin IDs that are blocked even if allowlists or paths include them. Use deny rules for emergency rollback and hard blocks on risky plugins.

paths.title: Plugin Load Paths
paths.description: Additional plugin files or directories scanned by the loader beyond built-in defaults. Use dedicated extension directories and avoid broad paths with unrelated executable content.

load.title: Plugin Loader
load.description: Plugin loader configuration group for specifying filesystem paths where plugins are discovered. Keep load paths explicit and reviewed to avoid accidental untrusted extension loading.

memory.title: Memory Plugin
memory.description: Select the active memory plugin by id, or "none" to disable memory plugins.

contextEngine.title: Context Engine Plugin
contextEngine.description: Selects the active context engine plugin by id so one plugin provides context orchestration behavior.

slots.title: Plugin Slots
slots.description: Selects which plugins own exclusive runtime slots such as memory so only one plugin provides that capability. Use explicit slot ownership to avoid overlapping providers with conflicting behavior.

enabled.title: Plugin Enabled
enabled.description: Per-plugin enablement override for a specific entry, applied on top of global plugin policy. With the default hybrid reload mode, changes hot-reload the plugin runtime for new agent turns without restarting the Gateway unless the plugin requires a restart for this path. Use this to stage plugin rollout gradually across environments.

allowPromptInjection.title: Allow Prompt Injection Hooks
allowPromptInjection.description: Controls whether this plugin may mutate prompts through typed hooks. Set false to block `before_prompt_build`.

allowConversationAccess.title: Allow Conversation Access Hooks
allowConversationAccess.description: Controls whether this plugin may read raw conversation content from typed hooks such as `before_agent_run`, `before_model_resolve`, `before_agent_reply`, `llm_input`, `llm_output`, `before_agent_finalize`, and `agent_end`. Non-bundled plugins must opt in explicitly.

timeoutMs.title: Plugin Hook Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for this plugin's typed hooks, capped at 600000. Use this to bound slow plugin hooks without changing plugin code; per-hook values in hooks.timeouts take precedence.

timeouts.title: Plugin Hook Timeout Overrides
timeouts.description: Per-hook timeout overrides in milliseconds keyed by typed hook name, capped at 600000. Use narrow overrides for known slow hooks such as before_prompt_build or agent_end instead of raising every hook timeout.

hooks.title: Plugin Hook Policy
hooks.description: Per-plugin typed hook policy controls for core-enforced safety gates. Use this to constrain high-impact hook categories without disabling the entire plugin.

allowModelOverride.title: Allow Plugin Subagent Model Override
allowModelOverride.description: Explicitly allows this plugin to request provider/model overrides in background subagent runs. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted to steer model selection.

allowedModels.title: Plugin Subagent Allowed Models
allowedModels.description: Allowed override targets for trusted plugin subagent runs as canonical "provider/model" refs. Use "*" only when you intentionally allow any model.

subagent.title: Plugin Subagent Policy
subagent.description: Per-plugin subagent runtime controls for model override trust and allowlists. Keep this unset unless a plugin must explicitly steer subagent model selection.

allowModelOverride.title: Allow Plugin LLM Model Override
allowModelOverride.description: Explicitly allows this plugin to request model overrides in api.runtime.llm.complete. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted to steer model selection.

allowedModels.title: Plugin LLM Allowed Models
allowedModels.description: Allowed override targets for trusted plugin LLM calls as canonical "provider/model" refs. Use "*" only when you intentionally allow any model override.

allowedCompletionModels.title: Plugin LLM Allowed Completion Models
allowedCompletionModels.description: Allowed targets for every plugin LLM completion as canonical "provider/model" refs, including host-resolved defaults and overrides. Use "*" only when you intentionally allow any model.

allowAuthProfileOverride.title: Allow Plugin LLM Auth Profile Override
allowAuthProfileOverride.description: Allows this plugin to select a non-default auth profile for isolated agent-runtime completions. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted for explicit isolated credential routing.

allowAgentIdOverride.title: Allow Plugin LLM Agent Override
allowAgentIdOverride.description: Explicitly allows this plugin to request api.runtime.llm.complete against a non-default agent id. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted for cross-agent model access.

llm.title: Plugin LLM Policy
llm.description: Per-plugin api.runtime.llm.complete controls for model and agent override trust. Keep this unset unless a plugin must explicitly steer host-owned completion calls.

config.title: Plugin Config
config.description: Plugin-defined configuration payload interpreted by that plugin's own schema and validation rules. Use only documented fields from the plugin to prevent ignored or invalid settings.

entries.title: Plugin Entries
entries.description: Per-plugin settings keyed by plugin ID including enablement and plugin-specific runtime configuration payloads. Use this for scoped plugin tuning without changing global loader policy.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Plugin system controls for enabling extensions, constraining load scope, configuring entries, and tracking installs. Keep plugin policy explicit and least-privilege in production environments.

silentReply.title: Surface Silent Reply Policy
silentReply.description: Overrides silent-reply policy for one resolved delivery surface. Unset fields inherit agents.defaults.silentReply; use narrow surface ids so internal or group-specific behavior does not spill into other destinations.

surfaces.title: Surface Policies
surfaces.description: Per-surface message policy overrides keyed by the resolved delivery surface id. Use this only when one deployed surface needs stricter silent-reply handling than the agent default.

enabled.title: Managed Proxy Enabled
enabled.description: Explicit managed-proxy override. URL presence enables routing by default; set false to ignore configured or environment proxy URLs without deleting them.

proxyUrl.title: Managed Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Managed forward proxy URL. Use http:// for a plain CONNECT proxy or https:// when the connection to the proxy endpoint itself must use TLS.

caFile.title: Managed Proxy TLS CA File
caFile.description: Filesystem path to a custom CA bundle used to verify an HTTPS managed proxy endpoint certificate.

tls.title: Managed Proxy TLS
tls.description: TLS settings used when connecting to the managed proxy endpoint. These settings apply to proxy TLS, not destination TLS after CONNECT.

loopbackMode.title: Managed Proxy Loopback Mode
loopbackMode.description: Controls Gateway loopback control-plane routing while managed proxy mode is active: "gateway-only", "proxy", or "block".

proxy.title: Managed Proxy
proxy.description: Operator-managed forward proxy routing for OpenClaw runtime HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, and supported raw-egress paths. Use this when central egress control is part of the deployment boundary.

wizard.label: Setup Preferences
wizard.help: User-owned setup preferences. Machine-owned wizard history and acknowledgement state live in the shared state database.

update.label: Updates
update.help: Update-channel and startup-check behavior for keeping OpenClaw runtime versions current. Use conservative channels in production and more experimental channels only in controlled environments.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Diagnostics controls for targeted tracing, telemetry export, and cache inspection during debugging. Keep baseline diagnostics minimal in production and enable deeper signals only when investigating issues.

telemetry.label: Telemetry
telemetry.help: Explicit consent for anonymous feature statistics attached to the daily update check. Feature statistics are disabled by default and never include messages, credentials, or identifiers.

logging.label: Logging
logging.help: Logging behavior controls for severity, output destinations, formatting, and sensitive-data redaction. Keep levels and redaction strict enough for production while preserving useful diagnostics.

gateway.label: Gateway
gateway.help: Gateway runtime surface for bind mode, auth, control UI, remote transport, and operational safety controls. Keep conservative defaults unless you intentionally expose the gateway beyond trusted local interfaces.

nodeHost.label: Node Host
nodeHost.help: Node host controls for features exposed from this gateway node to other nodes or clients. Keep defaults unless you intentionally proxy local capabilities across your node network.

cloudWorkers.label: Cloud Workers
cloudWorkers.help: Opt-in cloud worker profiles for disposable remote environments. When this section is omitted or has no profiles, cloud worker creation remains unavailable and existing gateway/node status behavior is unchanged.

agents.label: Agents
agents.help: Agent runtime configuration root. Root siblings own infrastructure and cross-agent defaults; agents.defaults owns agent-loop behavior; agent entries may override either where supported.

tools.label: Tools
tools.help: Tool infrastructure and cross-agent defaults. Root siblings own infrastructure and cross-agent defaults; agents.defaults owns agent-loop behavior; agent entries may override either where supported.

bindings.label: Bindings
bindings.help: Top-level binding rules for routing and persistent ACP conversation ownership. Use type=route for normal routing and type=acp for persistent ACP harness bindings.

models.label: Models
models.help: Model catalog root for provider definitions, merge/replace behavior, and optional Bedrock discovery integration. Keep provider definitions explicit and validated before relying on production failover paths.

messages.label: Messages
messages.help: Message infrastructure and cross-agent defaults. Root siblings own infrastructure and cross-agent defaults; agents.defaults owns agent-loop behavior; agent entries may override either where supported.

commands.label: Commands
commands.help: Controls chat command surfaces, owner gating, and elevated command access behavior across providers. Keep defaults unless you need stricter operator controls or broader command availability.

session.label: Session
session.help: Global session routing, reset, delivery policy, and maintenance controls for conversation history behavior. Keep defaults unless you need stricter isolation, retention, or delivery constraints.

cron.label: Automations
cron.help: Global scheduler settings for stored automations, run concurrency, delivery fallback, and run-session retention. Keep defaults unless you are scaling automation volume or integrating external webhook receivers.

worktreeRoot.label: Worktree Root
worktreeRoot.help: Global directory for new managed worktrees. Use an absolute path or ~ for your home directory; defaults to <state-dir>/worktrees. Existing worktrees keep their recorded paths when this changes.

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.help: Inbound webhook automation surface for mapping external events into wake or agent actions in OpenClaw. Keep this locked down with explicit token/session/agent controls before exposing it beyond trusted networks.

ui.label: UI
ui.help: UI presentation settings for accenting and operator display preferences. Use this for readability customization without changing runtime behavior.

browser.label: Browser
browser.help: Browser runtime controls for local or remote CDP attachment, profile routing, and screenshot/snapshot behavior. Keep defaults unless your automation workflow requires custom browser transport settings.

talk.label: Talk
talk.help: Talk-mode voice synthesis settings for voice identity, model selection, output format, and interruption behavior. Use this section to tune human-facing voice UX while controlling latency and cost.

channels.label: Channels
channels.help: Channel provider configurations plus shared defaults that control access policies, heartbeat visibility, and per-surface behavior. Keep defaults centralized and override per provider only where required.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.help: Plugin system controls for enabling extensions, constraining load scope, configuring entries, and tracking installs. Keep plugin policy explicit and least-privilege in production environments.

discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.help: Service discovery settings for local mDNS advertisement and optional wide-area presence signaling. Keep discovery scoped to expected networks to avoid leaking service metadata.

tts.label: Text-to-Speech
tts.help: Text-to-speech policy for reading agent replies aloud on supported voice or audio surfaces. Keep disabled unless voice playback is part of your operator/user workflow.

mcp.label: MCP
mcp.help: Global MCP server definitions managed by OpenClaw. Embedded OpenClaw and other runtime adapters can consume these servers without storing them inside runtime-owned project settings.

acp.label: ACP
acp.help: ACP runtime controls for enabling dispatch, selecting backends, constraining allowed agent targets, and selecting streamed turn projection behavior.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.help: Approval routing controls for forwarding exec and plugin approval requests to chat destinations outside the originating session. Keep these disabled unless operators need explicit out-of-band approval visibility.

env.label: Environment
env.help: Environment import and override settings used to supply runtime variables to the gateway process. Use this section to control shell-env loading and explicit variable injection behavior.

auth.label: Auth
auth.help: Authentication profile root used for multi-profile provider credentials and cooldown-based failover ordering. Keep profiles minimal and explicit so automatic failover behavior stays auditable.

secrets.label: Secrets
secrets.help: Secret reference providers, shared-store behavior, and optional subprocess egress protection.

broadcast.label: Broadcast
broadcast.help: Broadcast routing map for sending the same outbound message to multiple peer IDs per source conversation. Keep this minimal and audited because one source can fan out to many destinations.

proxy.label: Managed Proxy
proxy.help: Operator-managed forward proxy routing for OpenClaw runtime HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, and supported raw-egress paths. Use this when central egress control is part of the deployment boundary.

transcripts.label: Transcripts
transcripts.help: Core transcript capture settings for meeting notes, recording-capable agent tools, and configured live meeting auto-start sources. Meeting plugins capture durable notes by default; set enabled to false to opt out globally.

surfaces.label: Surface Policies
surfaces.help: Per-surface message policy overrides keyed by the resolved delivery surface id. Use this only when one deployed surface needs stricter silent-reply handling than the agent default.

meta.label: Compatibility Metadata
meta.help: Backward-readable compatibility metadata retained so older binaries can refuse unsafe config downgrades.

meta.lastTouchedVersion.label: Config Last Touched Version
meta.lastTouchedVersion.help: OpenClaw version that most recently wrote this config.

meta.migrations.label: Config Migration Markers
meta.migrations.help: Bounded compatibility markers for completed config migrations.

meta.migrations.modelPolicyAllowlist.label: Model Policy Allowlist Migration
meta.migrations.modelPolicyAllowlist.help: Records that legacy model-map restrictions were preserved or evaluated.

env.shellEnv.label: Shell Environment Import
env.shellEnv.help: Shell environment import controls for loading variables from your login shell during startup. Keep this enabled when you depend on profile-defined secrets or PATH customizations.

env.shellEnv.enabled.label: Shell Environment Import Enabled
env.shellEnv.enabled.help: Enables loading environment variables from the user shell profile during startup initialization. Keep enabled for developer machines, or disable in locked-down service environments with explicit env management.

env.shellEnv.timeoutMs.label: Shell Environment Import Timeout (ms)
env.shellEnv.timeoutMs.help: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for shell environment resolution before fallback behavior applies. Use tighter timeouts for faster startup, or increase when shell initialization is heavy.

env.vars.label: Environment Variable Overrides
env.vars.help: Explicit key/value environment variable overrides merged into runtime process environment for OpenClaw. Use this for deterministic env configuration instead of relying only on shell profile side effects.

secrets.egressProxy.label: Secret Egress Proxy
secrets.egressProxy.help: Gateway-owned loopback proxy that replaces shared-store secret sentinels only at outbound request time. Restart the Gateway after changing this startup-scoped section.

secrets.egressProxy.enabled.label: Secret Egress Proxy Enabled
secrets.egressProxy.enabled.help: Enables secret egress substitution for Gateway-hosted agent subprocesses. Default: false.

secrets.egressProxy.allowedHosts.label: Secret Egress Proxy Allowed Hosts
secrets.egressProxy.allowedHosts.help: Opt-in traffic allowlist for requests and CONNECT tunnels. When present, destinations must appear in this list, a per-secret host binding, or bypassHosts. An empty list permits only bound or bypassed hosts. Restart the Gateway after changing it.

secrets.egressProxy.bypassHosts.label: Secret Egress Proxy Bypass Hosts
secrets.egressProxy.bypassHosts.help: Exact hostnames that use authenticated blind CONNECT tunnels for certificate-pinned clients. Sentinels remain ciphertext and will fail vendor authentication instead of exposing plaintext.

wizard.accessMode.label: Setup Discovery Access
wizard.accessMode.help: Discovery consent for guided setup: "full" scans silently while "guarded" asks before inspecting local applications.

wizard.appRecommendations.label: Setup App Recommendations
wizard.appRecommendations.help: Controls whether guided setup may use installed-application labels to recommend relevant plugins and skills.

wizard.lastRunAt.label: Wizard Last Run Timestamp
wizard.lastRunAt.help: Timestamp of the last successfully committed wizard run.

wizard.lastRunVersion.label: Wizard Last Run Version
wizard.lastRunVersion.help: OpenClaw version used by the last wizard run.

wizard.lastRunCommit.label: Wizard Last Run Commit
wizard.lastRunCommit.help: Source commit used by the last development wizard run.

wizard.lastRunCommand.label: Wizard Last Run Command
wizard.lastRunCommand.help: Command that invoked the last wizard run.

wizard.lastRunMode.label: Wizard Last Run Mode
wizard.lastRunMode.help: Whether the last wizard run targeted "local" or "remote" setup.

wizard.securityAcknowledgedAt.label: Wizard Security Acknowledgement Timestamp
wizard.securityAcknowledgedAt.help: Timestamp of the setup security acknowledgement, committed with the target config.

logging.audit.label: Audit Ledger
logging.audit.help: Bounded metadata-only audit history for operator review. Run and tool records are enabled by default; message lifecycle metadata is a separate privacy-sensitive opt-in. The background writer is best-effort rather than a lossless compliance archive.

logging.audit.enabled.label: Audit Ledger Enabled
logging.audit.enabled.help: Records new run, tool, and enabled message audit events. Default: true. Disabling event inserts does not immediately delete existing records; retained rows remain queryable until they expire.

logging.audit.executionIdentity.label: Execution Identity Audit
logging.audit.executionIdentity.help: Retains bounded execution-identity attribution for exact-run inspection. Default: false. Requires logging.audit.enabled; restart the Gateway after changing it.

logging.audit.messages.label: Message Audit Scope
logging.audit.messages.help: Controls content-free message lifecycle records: "off" (default), "direct" for known direct conversations only, or "all" for direct, group, channel, and unknown conversation kinds. Both logging.audit.enabled and logging.audit.messages are startup-scoped; restart the Gateway after changing either setting.

diagnostics.otel.label: OpenTelemetry
diagnostics.otel.help: OpenTelemetry export settings for traces, metrics, and logs emitted by gateway components. Use this when integrating with centralized observability backends and distributed tracing pipelines.

diagnostics.cacheTrace.label: Cache Trace
diagnostics.cacheTrace.help: Cache-trace logging settings for observing cache decisions and payload context in embedded runs. Enable this temporarily for debugging and disable afterward to reduce sensitive log footprint.

logging.level.label: Log Level
logging.level.help: Primary log level threshold for runtime logger output: "silent", "fatal", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", or "trace". Keep "info" or "warn" for production, and use debug/trace only during investigation.

logging.file.label: Log File Path
logging.file.help: Optional file path for persisted log output in addition to or instead of console logging. Use a managed writable path and align retention/rotation with your operational policy.

logging.consoleLevel.label: Console Log Level
logging.consoleLevel.help: Console-specific log threshold: "silent", "fatal", "error", "warn", "info", "debug", or "trace" for terminal output control. Use this to keep local console quieter while retaining richer file logging if needed.

logging.consoleStyle.label: Console Log Style
logging.consoleStyle.help: Console output format style: "pretty" or "json". Use json for machine parsing pipelines and pretty for human-first terminal workflows.

logging.redactPatterns.label: Custom Redaction Patterns
logging.redactPatterns.help: Additional custom redact regex patterns applied to log output, persisted transcript text, and safety-boundary UI/tool/diagnostic payloads before emission. Use this to mask org-specific tokens and identifiers not covered by built-in redaction rules.

update.channel.label: Update Channel
update.channel.help: Update channel for git + npm installs ("stable", "extended-stable", "beta", or "dev"). Extended-stable is package-only: installation is foreground-only, with optional read-only startup hints.

update.checkOnStart.label: Update Check on Start
update.checkOnStart.help: Checks the OpenClaw update endpoint when the gateway starts, including read-only extended-stable hints (default: true). Set false to disable update checks and anonymous update pings.

update.auto.enabled.label: Auto Update Enabled
update.auto.enabled.help: Enable background auto-update for stable and beta package installs; extended-stable never auto-applies (default: false).

telemetry.enabled.label: Anonymous Feature Statistics
telemetry.enabled.help: Shares enabled channel and provider names, plugin count, and recent session count with the daily update check. Disabled by default and always disabled when DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

telemetry.consentedAt.label: Feature Statistics Consent Timestamp
telemetry.consentedAt.help: ISO timestamp recording when the operator accepted or declined anonymous feature statistics. Prevents the setup wizard from asking again.

surfaces.*.silentReply.label: Surface Silent Reply Policy
